import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
whole place holding the next. -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- Three static leaves owned by frame 0 (§47): place 0 `Init`, places 1 and 2 `Uninit`. -/
def st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- `S3.init st` (§47). -/
def s0 : S3 := S3.init st
/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 3 held by frame 0. -/
def s1 : S3 := deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify
/-- After `alloc(provider 0, owner 1, one leaf)` (§71): place 3 owned by place 1, root 3. -/
def s2 : S3 := allocEff s0 1 [(none, 0)]
/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
place 0. -/
def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
/-- After `pin(0)` (§74): obligation 0 pins leaf 0. -/
def s4 : S3 := pinEff s0 0

example : StaticsOK st := by decide
example : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify := by decide
example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide
example : ReleasePre s1 3 := by decide
example : TransferPre K0 s0 0 1 := by decide
example : ¬ TransferPre K0 s0 1 0 := by decide
example : DependPre s1 2 3 := by decide
example : EnterPre s1 [3] [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
example : StorePre s1 3 1 := by decide
example : ¬ ExitPre K0 s0 := by decide
example : Read3Pre s0 0 [0] := by decide
example : Write3Pre s0 1 [1] := by decide
example : WriteSharedPre K0 s0 0 [0] := by decide
example : EndUsePre K0 s0 0 := by decide
example : FreePre K0 s2 3 0 := by decide
example : AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide

example : PinPre s0 0 := by decide

example : ¬ UnpinPre K0 s0 0 := by decide
example : ¬ EndUsePre K0 s4 0 := by decide

/-- §75: `unpin` ends only the designated obligation; with two obligations on leaf 0, ending
obligation 0 leaves the leaf pinned by obligation 1. -/
example : (unpinEff (pinEff s4 0) 0).pin 0 = true ∧ (unpinEff s4 0).pin 0 = false := by decide

/-- §63.8 decides alone: in `s3`, the transfer of place 0 to place 1 satisfies §63.1–§63.7 and
§63.9 and is rejected by local self-blocking prevention. -/
example : (s3.Usable 0 ∧ s3.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 1 ∧
    SameShape s3.P 0 1 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, s3.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 1, s3.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s3.P 0 1 ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s3.A.length, Grounds s3 .modify 0 g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s3.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s3 0 j → RightChain s3 g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, ¬ K0.Pinned l ∧ s3.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s3 0, s3.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s3 0 1) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s3.A.length, AnchorMoves s3 0 x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s3 0 1).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s3 0 1) x ((transferEff s3 0 1).pframe q)) True) ∧
    (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable 1) ∧
    ¬ NoLocalSelfLock s3 0 1 ∧ ¬ TransferPre K0 s3 0 1 := by decide

end Examples

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75): the step relation of the operation. -/
def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m => DeriveStep src region m
  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs
  | .release a => ReleaseStep a
  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst
  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls

/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩

    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
    | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _, h⟩
    | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
    | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
    | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
    | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
    | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
    | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨op, h⟩
    cases op with
    | derive => exact .derive h
    | split => exact .split h
    | release => exact .release h
    | transfer => exact .transfer h
    | depend => exact .depend h
    | enter => exact .enter h
    | exit => exact .exit h
    | read => exact .read h
    | write => exact .write h
    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
    | pin => exact .pin h
    | unpin => exact .unpin h
    | endUse => exact .endUse h
    | free => exact .free h
    | alloc => exact .alloc h
    | store => exact .store h

/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
  | refl : KStar k s s
/-! ## Preservation by every step (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv`
and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57, used by `transfer`, §63) to its `ok`
outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves hinv hheld h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv h
  | read => exact read_preserves hinv h
  | write => exact write_preserves hinv h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv h
  | free => exact free_preserves hinv h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv h
  | store => exact store_preserves hinv h

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40,
§49.7; not a clause of §57) from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` to its `ok`
outcome. -/
theorem op_preserves_kAux {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | split => exact split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | release => exact release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_kAux haux h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves_kAux haux h
  | read => exact read_preserves_kAux haux h
  | write => exact write_preserves_kAux haux h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_kAux haux h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves_kAux haux h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_kAux haux h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_kAux haux h
  | free => exact free_preserves_kAux haux h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
  | store => exact store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h

/-- Every operation preserves `I5` (§57: every leaf pinned statically or by an active obligation
of §74 belongs to a usable place) from a `WF3` state (§49) to its `ok` outcome. `WF3` is used by
`transfer` (§63.9), `endUse` (§69) and `free` (§70). -/
theorem op_preserves_i5 {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s)
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : I5 k s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | split => exact split_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | release => exact release_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | read => exact read_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | write => exact write_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | free => exact free_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | store => exact store_preserves_i5 h5 h

/-- Every kernel step preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv` and the auxiliary
`HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57), under `DDSound` (§80). -/
theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : KStep k s s') : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves hdd hinv hheld hop

/-- Every kernel step preserves `I5` (§57, §74) from a `WF3` state (§49). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s) (h : KStep k s s') :
    I5 k s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_i5 hw h5 hop

/-- Every kernel step preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7) from a state satisfying `KInv`
(§57) and `KAux`. -/
theorem kstep_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop

/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/

/-- An active derived authority of the resulting state held by place `q` is an anchor of `q`
(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/
private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (hstep : ∀ x y q, s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
      y.holder = .place q → x ∈ s'.D q ∨ ∃ y₀ : Authority, s.A[x]? = some y₀ ∧
        y₀.active = true ∧ y₀.origin ≠ none ∧ y₀.holder = .place q ∧
        (s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q → x ∈ s'.D q)) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  intro x y q hy ya ho hhq _
  rcases hstep x y q hy ya ho hhq with h | ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, ho₀, hh₀, himp⟩
  · exact h
  · have hu : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y₀ hy₀ ya₀; rw [hh₀] at this; exact this
    exact himp hu (hh x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh₀ hu)

/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
`derive`, `split`, `enterFrame`, `alloc`). -/
private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
  by_cases hx : x < l.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

/-- Every operation preserves the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57) from a `WF3`
state (§44; §60–§75 `ok` effects): new
authorities are held by frames or have no origin; `store` anchors what it stores (§65); a
`transfer` moves an authority with the anchors of its holder (§63); `exitFrame` maps a surviving
anchor to itself (§73); the other steps only release authorities or keep the anchors of the
places whose authorities stay active. -/
theorem op_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive src region m =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    exact ⟨kstep_preserves hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 h, kstep_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 h,
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩

/-- The main invariant of §57: on states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`
(§80), `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` holds, for well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`,
§47). -/
theorem reachable_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : KInv s :=
  (reachable_inv hdd hst h).1

/-- `I5` (§57) on reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every leaf
pinned statically (`K.Pinned`) or by an active obligation (§74) belongs to a usable place in every
reachable state. No hypothesis on `K.Pinned`: initially every static is usable (§47) and a leaf
lies in its own footprint (§40). -/
theorem reachable_i5 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : I5 k s := by
  induction h with
  | init =>
    intro l hlt hleaf _
    exact ⟨l, init_usable hst (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) (by rwa [initP_len] at hlt),
      mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlt, hleaf, hlt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  | step hr h ih => exact kstep_preserves_i5 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 ih h

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Lemmas

/-!
# Access kernel: the preserved invariant

The conjunction that every kernel step must preserve (§57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`) and the auxiliary invariant carried with it. The per-operation preservation modules state their results with these two predicates.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The kernel invariant of §57: `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInv (s : S3) : Prop := WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s

/-- Auxiliary invariant carried with `KInv`, not a clause of §57 (§40, §49.7): the converse
root-holder property `RootHeldConv`, which is not a clause of `WF3`. -/
def KAux (s : S3) : Prop := RootHeldConv s

/-- `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3` (§54, §49.7), so `KInv` reduces to its first three
conjuncts. -/
theorem kInv_of {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3 s) (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : KInv s :=
  ⟨hw, hi, ha, noOrphan_of_wf3 hw⟩

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `depend` preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53): only `D` changes, and the new anchor
is active (§64.2). -/
theorem depend_preserves_base {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3base s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have i3 := hi.2.2.1
  refine sameA_base hw hi rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl fun r hr y hy => ?_
  rcases depend_D hy with hy | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  · exact i3 r hr y hy
  · exact hpre.anchorActive

/-- `depend` preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44): the new anchor satisfies §64.3. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine anchorOrder_of (s := s) rfl rfl rfl (effAnchorOK_of_A rfl rfl rfl) fun r hr y hy => ?_
  rcases depend_D hy with hy | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hao r hr y hy
  · exact hpre.anchorOrder

/-- `depend` preserves `NoDangling` (§54): authorities and places are unchanged. -/
theorem depend_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact noDangling_skel hnd (skel_of_A rfl) rfl rfl rfl

/-- `depend` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44): authorities and places are unchanged. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (haoh : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact sameA_anchorOrderHeld haoh rfl rfl rfl rfl

/-- `depend` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7): authorities and places are unchanged. -/
theorem depend_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hc : RootHeldConv s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact sameA_rootHeldConv hc rfl rfl

/-- `depend` preserves `KInv` (§57, §58, §64); the auxiliary `KAux` is preserved by
`depend_preserves_rootHeldConv`. -/
theorem depend_preserves {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨hb, ho, hnd⟩, hh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kinv_of_parts (depend_preserves_base hw hb h) (depend_preserves_anchorOrder ho h)
    (depend_preserves_noDangling hnd h) (depend_preserves_anchorOrderHeld hh h)

/-- `depend` preserves `I5` (§57, §64 `ok` effect): places, stack, death markers and pinning
  · exact .inl hx

/-- `store` preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53): the stored authority is derived, keeps
its skeleton, is held by a usable place (§65.2) and joins the anchors of `p` while active. -/
theorem store_preserves_base {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3base s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
  obtain ⟨hP, hF, hn, hd⟩ := store_eqs s a p
  have i3 := hi.2.2.1
  refine ⟨wf3_skel hw (store_skel hy) hP hF hn hd (store_root hy ho) fun j z hz za => ?_,
    inv3base_skel hi (store_skel hy) hP hF hd fun q hq x hx => ?_⟩
  · rw [store_get hy] at hz; split at hz
    · cases hz; exact hpre.usable
    · exact hw.holders j z hz za
  · rcases store_D hy hx with hx | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact i3 q hq x hx
    · exact ⟨y, hy, ya⟩

/-- `store` preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44): the new anchor satisfies §65.4, and the effective
anchors keep their holders since `a` is derived. -/
theorem store_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
  obtain ⟨hP, hF, -, hd⟩ := store_eqs s a p
  refine anchorOrder_of hP hF hd (effAnchorOK_skel hw (store_skel hy) hP hF (store_root hy ho))
    fun q hq x hx => ?_
  rcases store_D hy hx with hx | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hao q hq x hx
  · exact hpre.anchorOrder

/-- `store` preserves `NoDangling` (§54): footprints, activity and usability are unchanged. -/
theorem store_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
  obtain ⟨hP, hF, -, hd⟩ := store_eqs s a p
  exact noDangling_skel hnd (store_skel hy) hP hF hd

/-- `store` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44): it is the resulting-state precondition §65.5. -/
theorem store_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hpre.anchorOrderHeld

/-- `store` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7): a root authority is never stored (§65.1). -/
theorem store_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hc : RootHeldConv s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
  exact rootHeldConv_of hc (store_eqs s a p).1 fun i z hzo hz => (store_root hy ho i z hzo).1 hz

/-- `store` preserves `KInv` (§57, §58, §65); the auxiliary `KAux` is preserved by
`store_preserves_rootHeldConv`. -/
theorem store_preserves {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨hb, ho, hnd⟩, -, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kinv_of_parts (store_preserves_base hw hb h) (store_preserves_anchorOrder hw ho h)
    (store_preserves_noDangling hnd h) (store_preserves_anchorOrderHeld h)

/-- `store` preserves `I5` (§57, §65 `ok` effect): places, stack, death markers and pinning
obligations are unchanged. -/
theorem store_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h5 : I5 k s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : I5 k s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: preservation by `enterFrame` and `exitFrame`

Operations O6 `enterFrame` (§72) and O7 `exitFrame` (§73) of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, with the frame rules of §39 and the parameter and
reanchoring rules of §45. Both steps preserve the kernel invariant of §57 (`KInv`, with the active
origins of `I2`, §51) and, separately, the auxiliary invariant `KAux` (not a clause of §57) and
`I5` (§57). The file also proves entry protection of parameters (§72.3 and
the last paragraph of §72), the release of authorities whose holder dies at the exit (§73
effect, §39), the absence of dangling authorities after the exit (§73, §54), reanchoring to the
first surviving active origin (§73.4, §73 effect), and determinism of both steps (§58).

Helper lemmas live in the namespace `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Frames`.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Frames

/-! ## Lists -/

/-- Indices of `List.range` are strictly increasing (§72: identities of the root locals). -/
    (hd : s.dead q = false) (h : HolderLive s pl.owner) : s.Usable q := by

  | frame f => rw [ho] at h; exact .frame hpl hd ho h
  | place o => rw [ho] at h; exact .place hpl hd ho h

/-! ## Places after `enterFrame` (§72 `ok` effect) -/

section Enter

variable {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}

/-- The locals are appended to the places (§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enterP_len (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) :
theorem enter_rootHeld (hwf : WF3 s) (hpre : EnterPre s ps ls) : RootHeld (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro r hrp hur
  by_cases hr : r < s.P.length
  · have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := ⟨hr, by rw [← enter_parentOf_lt hr]; exact hrp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ :=
      hwf.rootHeld r hrp0 (enter_usable_back hwf hur hr)
    have hni : i ∉ ps := fun hm => by
      have h2 := hpre.params i hm
      simp only [OptP, hz] at h2; exact h2.2.2 zo
    refine ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hz), hz]; simp [hni], za, zo, zm,
      by show (enterP s ls)[r]? = _; rw [enterP_lt hr]; exact hpr, hzh, fun l => ?_⟩
    show _ ↔ l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) r
    rw [enter_footprint_old hpre.localsOK hr]; exact hzf l
  · have hrl := hrp.1
    rw [show (enterEff s ps ls).P = enterP s ls from rfl, enterP_len] at hrl
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, r = s.P.length + k := ⟨r - s.P.length, by omega⟩
    have hk : k < ls.length := by omega
    have hn : (ls.toShape[k]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
      have := hrp.2
      rw [show (enterEff s ps ls).P = enterP s ls from rfl, enter_parentOf_new hk] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := append_map_get
      (mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A)
      (fun i => (⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩ : Authority)) (mem_rootIdx hk hn)
    exact ⟨_, _, _, hj, rfl, rfl, rfl, enterP_new hk, shapeOwner_toShape _ _ _,
      fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §72): an authority without origin is not
a parameter and keeps its holder; a new root authority is held by the frame owning its local. -/
theorem enter_rootHeldConv (hwf : WF3 s) (hpre : EnterPre s ps ls) (hr : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro x z l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rcases enter_get hx with ⟨-, z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, i, hi, rfl⟩
  · have ho' : z₀.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
    have hl' : l ∈ z₀.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
    have hnp : x ∉ ps := fun hp => by
      have := hpre.params x hp; simp only [OptP, hz₀] at this; exact this.2.2 ho'
    have hlt := (hwf.footprints x z₀ hz₀ l hl').1
    have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (enter_partOf_old hlt).1 hlr
    have hrl : r < s.P.length := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (partOf_le hlr') hlt
    have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := ⟨hrl, by rw [← enter_parentOf_lt hrl]; exact hrp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z₀ l r hz₀ ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
    exact ⟨pr, by show (enterP s ls)[r]? = _; rw [enterP_lt hrl]; exact hpr, by simp [hnp, hh]⟩
  · obtain ⟨hil, hin⟩ := rootIdx_mem hi
    have hroot : RootPlace (enterEff s ps ls).P (s.P.length + i) :=
      ⟨by show s.P.length + i < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega,
        by show parentOf (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i) = none
           rw [enter_parentOf_new hil]; exact hin⟩
    obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp hroot hlr (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    exact ⟨_, enterP_new hil, rfl⟩

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `WF3` (§49, §72): the new frame is fresh, the locals are owned by it
with earlier parents, parameters move to it, and each root local receives its root authority. -/
theorem enter_wf (hwf : WF3 s) (hpre : EnterPre s ps ls) : WF3 (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  have hsh := hpre.localsOK
  have live : ∀ (hd : Holder), HolderLive s hd → HolderLive (enterEff s ps ls) hd := by
    intro hd hl; cases hd with
    | frame f => exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl
    | place p => exact enter_usable_old hl
  refine ⟨⟨by simp [enterEff], ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ⟨?_, ?_, fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩, ?_, ?_,
    enter_rootChain hwf hsh, enter_rootHeld hwf hpre, ?_⟩
  · exact List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨fun hm => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hwf.frames.2.2 _ hm), hwf.frames.2.1⟩
  · intro f hf; rcases List.mem_cons.1 hf with rfl | hf
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (hwf.frames.2.2 f hf)
  · intro q pl r hq hp
    rcases enterP_get hq with ⟨hq', hq''⟩ | ⟨hq', i, hi, rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hd⟩ := hwf.places q pl r hq'' hp
      refine ⟨pr, by show (enterP s ls)[r]? = _; rw [enterP_lt (by omega)]; exact hpr, hlt, ho, ?_⟩
      simp [enterEff, show ¬ s.P.length ≤ r by omega, show ¬ s.P.length ≤ q by omega, hd]
    · have h1 := shape_parent hsh hi hp
      have hri : r - s.P.length < ls.length := by omega
      have hr' := enterP_new (s := s) (ls := ls) hri
      rw [show s.P.length + (r - s.P.length) = r by omega] at hr'
      exact ⟨_, hr', by omega, rfl, by simp [enterEff, show s.P.length ≤ r by omega]⟩
  · intro q pl f hq ho
    rcases enterP_get hq with ⟨-, hq'⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, -, rfl⟩
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (hwf.owners.1 q pl f hq' ho)
    · cases ho; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
  · intro q pl o hq ho
    rcases enterP_get hq with ⟨-, hq'⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, -, rfl⟩
    · have := hwf.owners.2.1 q pl o hq' ho
      show o < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega
    · cases ho
  · intro a y hy l hl
    rcases enter_get hy with ⟨-, y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hlt, hleaf⟩ := hwf.footprints a y₀ hy₀ l (by split at hl <;> exact hl)
      exact ⟨by show l < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega,
        (enter_isLeaf_old hsh hlt).2 hleaf⟩
    · exact ⟨(mem_footprint.1 hl).1, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.1⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
    rcases enter_get hb with ⟨-, y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, _, -, rfl⟩
    · exact hwf.origins b y₀ a hy₀ (by split at ho <;> exact ho)
    · cases ho
  · intro a y hy ya
    rcases enter_get hy with ⟨-, y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, rfl⟩
    · have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
      split
      · exact (List.mem_cons_self .. : s.nF ∈ s.nF :: s.F)
      · exact live _ (hwf.holders a y₀ hy₀ ya₀)
    · exact (List.mem_cons_self .. : s.nF ∈ s.nF :: s.F)

/-! ## `enterFrame` preserves `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57, §72) -/

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `I1` (§50, §72): moving parameters changes only holders, and the root
authorities of the locals cover only the locals, pairwise disjointly. -/
theorem enter_i1 (hwf : WF3 s) (i1 : I1 s) : I1 (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro a b x y p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
  rcases enter_get ha with ⟨ha', x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨ha', i, hi, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases enter_get hb with ⟨hb', y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨hb', i', hi', rfl⟩
  · rw [enter_ancs_lt hb'] at hnab; rw [enter_ancs_lt ha'] at hnba
    have := i1 a b x₀ y₀ p hab hx₀ hy₀ (by split at xa <;> exact xa)
      (by split at ya <;> exact ya) (by split at xp <;> exact xp) (by split at yp <;> exact yp)
      hnab hnba
    constructor
    · split <;> exact this.1
    · split <;> exact this.2
  · have := (hwf.footprints a x₀ hx₀ p (by split at xp <;> exact xp)).1
    have := enter_root_fp_ge yp; omega
  · have := (hwf.footprints b y₀ hy₀ p (by split at yp <;> exact yp)).1
    have := enter_root_fp_ge xp; omega
  · have hk : a - s.A.length ≠ b - s.A.length := by omega
    have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => hk (rootIdx_inj hi (by rw [e]; exact hi'))
    exact (enter_roots_disjoint hii (rootIdx_mem hi).2 (rootIdx_mem hi').2 xp yp).elim

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53, §72): moving parameters changes only holders, the
root authorities of the locals have no origin, and the locals have no anchor. -/
theorem enter_inv3base (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) :
    Inv3base (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨enter_i1 hwf i1, ?_, ?_, i4_always _⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
    rcases enter_get hb with ⟨-, y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, _, -, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hm, hh, ha⟩ := i2 b y₀ a hy₀ (by split at ho <;> exact ho)
      refine ⟨_, by rw [enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hx₁), hx₁]; rfl, ?_, fun p hp => ?_, fun ya => ?_⟩
      · split <;> split <;> exact hm
      · have := hh p (by split at hp <;> exact hp)
        split <;> exact this
      · have := ha (by split at ya <;> exact ya)
        split <;> exact this
    · cases ho
  · intro q hq x hx
    by_cases hlt : q < s.P.length
    · have hx' : x ∈ s.D q := by simpa [enterEff, show ¬ s.P.length ≤ q by omega] using hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := i3 q (enter_usable_back hwf hq hlt) x hx'
      exact ⟨_, by rw [enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy), hy]; rfl, by split <;> exact ya⟩
    · simp [enterEff, show s.P.length ≤ q by omega] at hx

/-- The frame of an existing place is unchanged by `enterFrame` (§40, §72). -/
theorem enter_frameOf_old (hwf : WF3 s) {q f : Nat} (hq : q < s.P.length) :
    FrameOf (enterEff s ps ls) q f ↔ FrameOf s q f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    revert hq
    induction h with
    | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
      intro hq
      exact .frame (by have : (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl := hpl; rwa [enterP_lt hq] at this) ho
    | @place q o f pl hpl ho _ ih =>
      intro hq
      have hpl' : s.P[q]? = some pl := by
        have : (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl := hpl; rwa [enterP_lt hq] at this
      exact .place hpl' ho (ih (hwf.owners.2.1 q pl o hpl' ho))
  · intro h
    clear hq
    induction h with
    | frame hpl ho =>
      exact .frame (show (enterP s ls)[_]? = _ by rw [enterP_lt (lt_of_getElem? hpl)]; exact hpl) ho
    | place hpl ho _ ih =>
      exact .place (show (enterP s ls)[_]? = _ by rw [enterP_lt (lt_of_getElem? hpl)]; exact hpl)
        ho ih

/-- `placeFrame` of an existing place is unchanged by `enterFrame` (§40, §72). -/
theorem enter_pframe_old (hwf : WF3 s) {q : Nat} (hq : q < s.P.length) :
    (enterEff s ps ls).pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, enter_frameOf_old hwf hq]

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44, §72): frames of existing places do not change, the
new frame is not an ancestor of an existing one, and an effective anchor, having no origin, is
never a parameter. -/
theorem enter_anchorOrder (hwf : WF3 s) (hao : AnchorOrder s) (hpre : EnterPre s ps ls) :
    AnchorOrder (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro q hq x hx
  by_cases hlt : q < s.P.length
  · have hq0 := enter_usable_back hwf hq hlt
    have hx0 : x ∈ s.D q := by simpa [enterEff, show ¬ s.P.length ≤ q by omega] using hx
    have hok := hao q hq0 x hx0
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := effAnchorOK_get hok
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := effAnchorOK_frame hok hz
    have hxl := effAnchorOK_lt hok
    have he : (enterEff s ps ls).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
      effAnchor_congr (enter_ancs_lt hxl)
    have hrl : s.effAnchor x < s.A.length := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (effAnchor_le s x) hxl
    have hro : s.org (s.effAnchor x) = none := effAnchor_root hwf x
    have hnp : s.effAnchor x ∉ ps := fun hp => by
      have := hpre.params _ hp; simp only [OptP, hz] at this
      exact this.2.2 (by simpa [S3.org, hz] using hro)
    refine (effAnchorOK_of_same (s' := enterEff s ps ls) (z' := z) hz
      (by rw [he, enter_lt hrl, hz]; simp [hnp]) ?_ ?_ (enter_pframe_old hwf hlt)).2 hok
    · cases hh : z.holder with
      | frame f => rfl
      | place p =>
        rw [hh] at hg
        exact enter_pframe_old hwf (pframe_iff.1 hg).lt
    · intro g f hf
      obtain ⟨f', hf', hfF⟩ := hq0.frameOf
      rw [pframe_iff.2 hf'] at hf; rw [← Option.some.inj hf]
      exact ancestor_push fun e => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (e ▸ hwf.frames.2.2 _ hfF)
  · simp [enterEff, show s.P.length ≤ q by omega] at hx

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §72): existing places keep their footprints and
their usability; a new root authority covers only its local, which is usable. -/
theorem enter_noDangling (hwf : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s) (hpre : EnterPre s ps ls) :
    NoDangling (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨hlP, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  have hql : q ≤ l := partOf_le hlq
  rcases enter_get hz with ⟨-, y, hy, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, rfl⟩
  · have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by split at hlz <;> exact hlz
    have ya : y.active = true := by split at za <;> exact za
    have hqo : q < s.P.length := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hql (hwf.footprints j y hy l hly).1
    exact hnd j y hy ya q (fun hu => hq (enter_usable_old hu)) l
      ((enter_footprint_old hpre.localsOK hqo l).1 hl) hly
  · have hge : s.P.length ≤ l := enter_root_fp_ge hlz
    by_cases hqo : q < s.P.length
    · have := (mem_footprint.1 ((enter_footprint_old hpre.localsOK hqo l).1 hl)).1; omega
    · have hlP' : l < (enterP s ls).length := hlP
      rw [enterP_len] at hlP'
      have hu := enter_usable_new (s := s) (ps := ps) (ls := ls) (i := q - s.P.length) (by omega)
      rw [show s.P.length + (q - s.P.length) = q by omega] at hu
      exact hq hu

end Enter

/-- Live holder (§49.8): a frame of the stack or a usable place. -/
def HolderLive (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f ∈ s.F
  | .place p => s.Usable p

/-- Decidability of `HolderLive` (§49.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderLive s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderLive <;> infer_instance

/-! ## Frame of a place (§40, §44) -/

/-- Frame ending the ownership chain of `q`, searched within `k` steps (`placeFrame`, §40). -/
def pframeF (s : S3) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, _ => none
  | k + 1, q =>
    match s.P[q]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.owner with
      | .frame f => some f
      | .place o => pframeF s k o
/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants

/-!
# Access kernel: shared lemmas

Lemmas shared by the preservation proofs of the kernel operations of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75: origin and parent chains (§40, §42),
footprints and frames of places (§40), effective modes (§43), the grounding of a right (§43,
§63.4, §69.2, §70.3), exclusivity under `I1` (§50), active origins under `I2` (§51), additions of
authorities (§42, §60, §61), states with the same authorities up to holders (§63), consequences
of `WF3` (§49), usability (§40), root places (§40, §49.6, §49.7), the shape of `transfer` (§63),
`NoOrphan` from `WF3` (§54), and dynamic pinning obligations (§74, §75).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Chains (§40, §42, §49) -/

/-- A chain from an element without link is empty (§40 parents, §42 origins). -/
theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
  | 0 => rfl
  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]

/-- Any fuel at least the start index gives the same chain (§40, §42; acyclicity, §49). -/
theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
    ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [chainF]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
      · rfl
    · rfl

/-- The chain of an element without link is empty (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) : chain org i = [] :=
  chainF_none h i

/-- The chain of `i` is its link followed by the chain of the link (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_cons {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i o : Nat} (h : org i = some o) (hlt : o < i) :
    chain org i = o :: chain org o := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [chain, chainF, h, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [chainF_fuel org k o o (by omega) (Nat.le_refl o)]

/-- Elements of a chain are below its start (§49, acyclic chains). -/
theorem chainF_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i j, j ∈ chainF org k i → j < i
  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, j, h => by
    simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
    · split at h
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
        · assumption
theorem S3.Usable.mono {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : ∀ f ∈ s'.F, f ∈ s.F)
    (hd : ∀ q, s'.dead q = false → s.dead q = false) {q : Nat} (h : s'.Usable q) :
    s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | frame hpl hdq ho hf => exact .frame (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho (hF _ hf)
  | place hpl hdq ho _ ih => exact .place (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho ih

/-- Usability depends only on places, stack and death markers (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    {q : Nat} : s'.Usable q ↔ s.Usable q :=
  ⟨S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => hd ▸ h),
   S3.Usable.mono hP.symm (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => by rw [hd]; exact h)⟩

/-- Usability carries over between states with the same places, stack and death markers
(§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_eqs {s s' : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s'.Usable q) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono hP (fun _ h => hF ▸ h) (fun _ h => hd ▸ h) h

/-- Liveness of a holder depends only on places, stack and death markers (§49.8). -/
theorem HolderLive.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (h : Holder) : HolderLive s' h ↔ HolderLive s h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => simp [HolderLive, hF]
  | place p => exact S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd

/-- A place with the owner and the death marker of a usable place is usable (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_same {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pl pr : Place} (h : s.Usable q)
    (hq : s.P[q]? = some pl) (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (ho : pr.owner = pl.owner)
    (hd : s.dead r = s.dead q) : s.Usable r := by
  cases h with
  | frame hpl hdq hof hf =>
    rw [hq] at hpl; cases hpl; exact .frame hr (by rw [hd]; exact hdq) (by rw [ho]; exact hof) hf
  | place hpl hdq hof hu =>
    rw [hq] at hpl; cases hpl; exact .place hr (by rw [hd]; exact hdq) (by rw [ho]; exact hof) hu

/-- A part of a usable place is usable (§40: parts share owner and death marker; §49.2). -/
theorem usable_of_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n r q, r < n → partOf s.P r q → s.Usable q → s.Usable r
  | 0, _, _, h, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, q, hr, ⟨hlen, hrq⟩, hu => by
    rcases hrq with rfl | hc
    · exact hu
    cases hpo : parentOf s.P r with
    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hc; simp at hc
    | some p =>

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
§44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/

deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Structural parent of place `i` (§40). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf(p, q)` (§40): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` or one of its structural
ancestors. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants

Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC2.md` (WC2 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).

* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC2 C1–C3);
* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
  `ancestorC` (WC2 C3);
* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC2 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC2 C24);
* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC2 C20; Spec 1 §44,
  §49–§57 re-indexed);
* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
  membership agree on every view (WC2 C2).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## State (WC2 C1–C3) -/

/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC2 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
inductive Life where
  | live
  | done
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Execution context (WC2 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
structure Ctx where
  stack : List Nat
  life : Life
  parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC2 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC2 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC2 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC2 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC2 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC2 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC2 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC2 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => !(s.stk c).contains f }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC2 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC2 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC2 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC2 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC2 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC2 C3) -/

/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC2 C3; Spec 1
§39). -/
def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest

/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC2 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f

/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC2 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)

/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC2 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)

/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC2 C3). -/
instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance

/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC2 C2, C3) -/

/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC2 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC2 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC2 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeldC s) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeldC_iff.symm

/-! ## Invariants (WC2 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49–§57 re-indexed) -/

/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC2 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the
globally live frames). -/
structure FramesC (s : SC) : Prop where
  /-- WC2 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
  /-- WC2 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC2 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
  nodup : s.frames.Nodup
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1: every frame has a valid identity (below `nF`). -/
  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF
  /-- WC2 C3: the initial frame of a non-initial live context has a parent (the frame that
  created the context, or its reparenting target, WC2 C6). -/
  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC2 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
  parent : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, ∀ g, s.parC f = some g → g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f

/-- `ConcurrentWF` (WC2 C20): the frame structure of `FramesC` and `WF3` (Spec 1 §49.1–§49.8)
read with "the stack" as the globally live frames. -/
def ConcurrentWF (s : SC) : Prop := FramesC s ∧ WF3 s.flat

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` re-indexed (Spec 1 §50–§53, §57; WC2 C2): `I4` reads `Read3Pre`, which
depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/
def Inv3baseC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` re-indexed (Spec 1 §57; WC2 C2). -/
def Inv3C (s : SC) : Prop := Inv3baseC s ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ NoDangling s.flat

/-- `NoOrphan` re-indexed (Spec 1 §54; WC2 C2): chains start at a globally live frame. -/
def NoOrphanC (s : SC) : Prop := NoOrphan s.flat

/-- The kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (WC2 C20, C23):
`ConcurrentWF ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInvC (s : SC) : Prop := ConcurrentWF s ∧ Inv3C s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧ NoOrphanC s

/-! ## Views: membership and current frame (WC2 C2) -/

/-- Unfolding of `stk` (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.stk_of {s : SC} {c : Nat} {x : Ctx} (h : s.C[c]? = some x) (hl : x.life = .live) :
    s.stk c = x.stack := by simp [SC.stk, h, hl]

/-- A context with a nonempty stack is live (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.live_of_stk {s : SC} {c : Nat} (h : s.stk c ≠ []) : s.Live c := by
  unfold SC.stk at h; unfold SC.Live
  split at h
  · rename_i x hx; rw [hx]; simp only [OptP]; split at h
    · assumption
    · exact absurd rfl h
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- A frame of a stack is globally live (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_frames_of {s : SC} {c f : Nat} (h : f ∈ s.stk c) : f ∈ s.frames := by
  have hc : c < s.C.length := by
    unfold SC.stk at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · simp at h
  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨c, List.mem_range.2 hc, h⟩

/-- Globally live frames are the frames of some stack (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_frames {s : SC} {f : Nat} : f ∈ s.frames ↔ ∃ c, f ∈ s.stk c := by
  constructor
  · intro h; obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h; exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact SC.mem_frames_of hc

/-- The view of a context lists exactly the globally live frames (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_view_F {s : SC} {c f : Nat} : f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := by
  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, Bool.not_eq_true',
    List.contains_eq_false_iff_not_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩)
    · exact SC.mem_frames_of h
    · exact h
  · intro h
    by_cases hc : f ∈ s.stk c
    · exact .inl hc
    · exact .inr ⟨h, by simpa using hc⟩

/-- The stack of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC2 C3). -/
theorem SC.stk_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.stk c).Nodup := by
  by_cases hc : c < s.C.length
  · have := List.nodup_flatMap.1 hnd
    exact this.1 c (List.mem_range.2 hc)
  · simp [SC.stk, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)]

/-- The view of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC2 C3). -/
theorem SC.view_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.view c).F.Nodup := by
  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat]
  refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨SC.stk_nodup hnd c, hnd.filter _, fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩
  subst e
  simp only [List.mem_filter, Bool.not_eq_true', List.contains_eq_false_iff_not_mem] at hb
  exact (by simpa using hb.2 : a ∉ s.stk c) ha

/-- The current frame of the view of `c` is the top of the stack of `c` (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_top {s : SC} {c f : Nat} {rest : List Nat} (h : s.stk c = f :: rest) :
    (s.view c).top = f := by
  simp [SC.view, S3.top, h]

/-! ## Membership congruence (WC2 C2)

The clauses of `WF3`, `I1`–`I3`, `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (Spec 1 §49–§54) read the stack only
through membership; they agree on states that differ only by the order of the stack. -/

section Congr

variable {t : S3} {F' : Frames}

/-- Usability depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem usable_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) {q : Nat} :
    ({ t with F := F' } : S3).Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
  ⟨S3.Usable.mono rfl (fun f h => (hF f).1 h) (fun _ h => h),
   S3.Usable.mono rfl (fun f h => (hF f).2 h) (fun _ h => h)⟩

/-- Holder liveness depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §49.8). -/
theorem holderLive_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (h : Holder) :
    HolderLive ({ t with F := F' } : S3) h ↔ HolderLive t h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hF f
  | place p => exact usable_mem_congr hF

/-- `WF3` depends on the stack only through membership, duplicate-freedom and nonemptiness
(Spec 1 §49). -/
theorem wf3_mem_congr (hw : WF3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (hnd : F'.Nodup)
    (hne : F' ≠ []) : WF3 { t with F := F' } where
  frames := ⟨hne, hnd, fun f hf => hw.frames.2.2 f ((hF f).1 hf)⟩
  places := hw.places
  owners := ⟨hw.owners.1, hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)
    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr rfl).2 hf, (hF f).2 hfF⟩⟩
  footprints := hw.footprints
  origins := hw.origins
  rootChain := hw.rootChain
  rootHeld := fun r hr hu => hw.rootHeld r hr ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hu)
  holders := fun a y hy ya => (holderLive_mem_congr hF _).2 (hw.holders a y hy ya)

/-- `I3` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §52). -/
theorem i3_mem_congr (h : I3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : I3 { t with F := F' } :=
  fun q hq x hx => h q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq) x hx

/-- `NoDangling` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §54). -/
theorem noDangling_mem_congr (h : NoDangling t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) :
    NoDangling { t with F := F' } :=
  fun j y hy ya q hq => h j y hy ya q fun hu => hq ((usable_mem_congr hF).2 hu)

end Congr

/-- The view of a context is the flat state with a reordered stack (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_eq (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    s.view c = { s.flat with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl

/-- `WF3` of the flat state carries to every view (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.wf3_view {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat} :
    WF3 (s.view c) := by
  rw [SC.view_eq]
  refine wf3_mem_congr hw (fun f => SC.mem_view_F) (SC.view_nodup hfr.nodup c) ?_
  intro he
  have h0 := hfr.initial
  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
  · rename_i x hx
    have hs := hfr.nonempty 0 (by simp [SC.Live, hx, OptP, h0.1])
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs
    have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
    rw [he] at this; simp at this
  · exact h0.elim

/-- `WF3` of a view carries to the flat state (WC2 C2). -/
theorem SC.wf3_flat_of_view {s : SC} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) :
    WF3 s.flat := by
  have := wf3_mem_congr (t := s.view c) (F' := s.frames) hw
    (fun f => SC.mem_view_F.symm) hnd (fun he => by
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hw.frames.1
      have := SC.mem_view_F.1 hf; rw [he] at this; simp at this)
  exact this

end Ern.Concurrency
