import Ern.Concurrency.Context

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions

* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
  executed by a live context `c` (WC2 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC2 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
* `spawn` (WC2 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC2 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC2 C8);
* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.

Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/

/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
def Outcome3.map {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
  | .reject => .reject
  | .fail => .fail

/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC2 C2) -/

/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC2 C2). The context must be live;
otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = o₃.map s.set

/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/

/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC2 C2). -/
def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC2 C2): the clauses of
`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
      RightChain (s.view c) g j
  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
        y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
          y.holder = .place q →
            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst ∧ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-! ## O5 `depend` re-indexed (Spec 1 §64) -/

/-- Effect of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 effect, WC2 C2). -/
def dependEffC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : SC := s.set (dependEff (s.view c) q x)

/-- Preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 re-indexed, WC2 C2). -/
structure DependPreC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
  anchorActive : (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §64.3 re-indexed: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an
  `ancestorC` of it. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64). -/
instance (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPreC s c q x) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable q ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify q ∧ (s.view c).Active x ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-! ## O8 `store` re-indexed (Spec 1 §65) -/

/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC2 C2). -/
def storeEffC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : SC := s.set (storeEff (s.view c) a p)

/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC2 C2). -/
structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)
  relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65). -/
instance (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePreC s c a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False ∧ (s.view c).Usable p ∧ isLeaf (s.view c).P p ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
        l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC2 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC2 C2). -/
structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
  executing context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC2 C6) -/

/-- Reparenting (WC2 C6.3): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
parent `p`. -/
def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x

/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC2 C6): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to `p` (WC2 C6.3). -/
def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC2 C6.1: "O7's
applicable conditions"). The surviving frames are the other globally live frames. -/
structure ExitPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC2 C6): the current frame of `c` is not the initial frame of its
  context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC2 C2) -/

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
re-indexed, WC2 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
nothing. -/
def KernelOp.StepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o

/-! ## `spawn` (WC2 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC2 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
view of `c`. -/
def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }

/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC2 C4.1–C4.6), except the second half of
WC2 C4.6 ("the global authority invariants hold in the resulting state"), which the candidate does
not define (see the report). C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication) hold by
construction of `spawnEff`; C4.7 concerns `spawn` with a value (`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`). -/
structure SpawnPreBase (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC2 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC2 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC2 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC2 C4.5, C4 effect (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection evaluated in the resulting state with
  the new context as the executing context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC2 C4.6, first half (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting
  state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC2 C4). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (SpawnPreBase s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC2 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPreBase s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

/-! ## `terminate` (WC2 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/

/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC2 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC2 C6.3). -/
def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC2 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
ended). -/
structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC2 C7: a non-initial context (WC2 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
  /-- WC2 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC2 C7). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC2 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o

/-! ## `join` (WC2 C8) -/

/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC2 C8): `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` designates a known
context whose completed state is established. A live target has no outcome (waiting is a
non-enabled transition). WC2 C8 states no outcome for an unknown identifier and no effect on `C`
or `F_C`; the relation gives none (see the report). -/
inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)

/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC2 C2, C4, C6–C8):
an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : op.StepC k c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Frames

/-!
# Sequential conservativity (WC2 C24)

On single-context states (`SC.Single`: one context, the initial one, live, without parent) whose
frame structure satisfies `FramesC`:

* `ancestorC` coincides with `ancestor` of Spec 1 §39 on the stack of the context
  (`single_ancestorC`);
* `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC` and `KInvC` coincide with their Spec 1 counterparts on the
  projection `SC.toS3` (`single_anchorOrderC`, `single_anchorOrderHeldC`, `single_kInvC`);
* every inherited operation O1–O16 executed by the context has the outcomes of Spec 1 on the
  projection, and an `ok` outcome stays a single-context state whose projection is the Spec 1
  effect (`conservative_op`, `conservative_ok`).

The statement on `K_C.SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` is in `Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib`
(`conservative_deriveSync`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Lists -/

/-- `parIn` of an element absent from the stack is `none` (WC2 C3). -/
theorem parIn_not_mem {par : Option Nat} {f : Nat} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, f ∉ l → parIn par f l = none
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    have ha : a ≠ f := fun e => h (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
    simp only [parIn, ha, ↓reduceIte]
    exact parIn_not_mem fun hm => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)

/-- `parIn` ignores a head distinct from the frame (WC2 C3). -/
theorem parIn_cons_ne {par : Option Nat} {f a : Nat} {l : List Nat} (h : a ≠ f) :
    parIn par f (a :: l) = parIn par f l := by simp [parIn, h]

/-- In a strictly decreasing stack, the chain of `parIn` from a frame lists the frames below it
(WC2 C3; Spec 1 §39). -/
theorem chain_parIn : ∀ {F : List Nat}, F.Pairwise (· > ·) → ∀ {f : Nat}, f ∈ F →
    chain (fun g => parIn none g F) f = (F.dropWhile (· != f)).tail
  | [], _, _, hf => absurd hf List.not_mem_nil
  | a :: F, hd, f, hf => by
    obtain ⟨hlt, hdF⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.1 hd
    have hcongr : ∀ i, i < a →
        chain (fun g => parIn none g (a :: F)) i = chain (fun g => parIn none g F) i :=
      fun i hi => chain_congr fun j hj => parIn_cons_ne (by omega)
    by_cases e : a = f
    · subst e
      simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        List.tail_cons]
      cases F with
      | nil => exact chain_none (by simp [parIn])
      | cons b F' =>
        have hb : b < a := hlt b (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        rw [chain_cons (by simp [parIn]) hb, hcongr b hb,
          chain_parIn hdF (List.mem_cons_self ..)]
        simp
    · have hf' : f ∈ F := (List.mem_cons.1 hf).resolve_left (Ne.symm e)
      have hfa : f < a := hlt f hf'
      rw [hcongr f hfa, chain_parIn hdF hf']
      simp [List.dropWhile_cons, bne_iff_ne, e]

/-- `dropWhile (· != f)` of a list containing `f` starts with `f` (Spec 1 §39). -/
theorem dropWhile_ne_head : ∀ {F : List Nat} {f : Nat}, f ∈ F →
    F.dropWhile (· != f) = f :: (F.dropWhile (· != f)).tail
  | [], _, hf => absurd hf List.not_mem_nil
  | a :: F, f, hf => by
    by_cases e : a = f
    · subst e; simp
    · have hf' : f ∈ F := (List.mem_cons.1 hf).resolve_left (Ne.symm e)
      simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, e, not_false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      exact dropWhile_ne_head hf'

/-- `dropWhile (· != f)` of a list without `f` is empty (Spec 1 §39). -/
theorem dropWhile_ne_nil : ∀ {F : List Nat} {f : Nat}, f ∉ F → F.dropWhile (· != f) = []
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | a :: F, f, hf => by
    have e : a ≠ f := fun e => hf (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, e, not_false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    exact dropWhile_ne_nil fun h => hf (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

/-! ## Single-context states (WC2 C24) -/

section Single

variable {s : SC}

/-- The stack of the context of a single-context state (WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_C (hs : s.Single) : s.C = [⟨s.stk 0, .live, none⟩] := by
  obtain ⟨stk, hC⟩ := hs; rw [hC]; simp [SC.stk, hC]

/-- The context of a single-context state is live (WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_live (hs : s.Single) : s.Live 0 := by
  rw [SC.Live, single_C hs]; simp [OptP]

/-- The live frames of a single-context state are its stack (WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_frames (hs : s.Single) : s.frames = s.stk 0 := by
  have hC := single_C hs
  simp only [SC.frames, hC, List.length_singleton, List.range_one, List.flatMap_cons,
    List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]

/-- The flat state of a single-context state is its projection (WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_flat (hs : s.Single) : s.flat = s.toS3 := by
  simp only [SC.flat, SC.toS3, single_frames hs]

/-- The view of the context of a single-context state is its projection (WC2 C2, C24). -/
theorem single_view (hs : s.Single) : s.view 0 = s.toS3 := by
  simp only [SC.view, single_flat hs, single_frames hs, SC.toS3]
  congr 1
  have : (s.stk 0).filter (fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk 0)) = [] :=
    List.filter_eq_nil_iff.2 fun f hf => by simpa using hf
  rw [this, List.append_nil]

/-- The parent relation of a single-context state follows its stack (WC2 C3, C24). -/
theorem single_parC (hs : s.Single) (f : Nat) : s.parC f = parIn none f (s.stk 0) := by
  have hC := single_C hs
  have hp : s.ctxParent 0 = none := by simp [SC.ctxParent, hC]
  by_cases hf : f ∈ s.stk 0
  · have : s.ctxOf f = some 0 := by
      simp only [SC.ctxOf, hC, List.length_singleton, List.range_one, List.find?_cons]
      simp [hf]
    simp [SC.parC, this, hp]
  · have : s.ctxOf f = none := by
      simp only [SC.ctxOf, hC, List.length_singleton, List.range_one, List.find?_cons]
      simp [hf]
    simp [SC.parC, this, parIn_not_mem hf]

/-- WC2 C24 ("sequential ancestry is recovered"), WC2 C3 ("on corresponding single-context
states, it coincides exactly with Spec 1 §39"): on a single-context state with a strictly
decreasing stack, `ancestorC` is `ancestor` of Spec 1 §39 on the stack. -/
theorem single_ancestorC (hs : s.Single) (hd : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)) (g f : Nat) :
    s.ancestorC g f ↔ ancestor (s.stk 0) g f := by
  unfold SC.ancestorC ancestor
  rw [single_frames hs, show s.parC = fun g => parIn none g (s.stk 0) from
    funext (single_parC hs)]
  by_cases hf : f ∈ s.stk 0
  · rw [chain_parIn hd hf, dropWhile_ne_head hf]
    simp [hf]
  · rw [dropWhile_ne_nil hf]; simp [hf]

/-- The frame structure of a single-context state makes its stack strictly decreasing (WC2 C3;
Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem single_decreasing (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·) := by
  have hpar : ∀ f g, s.parC f = some g → g < f := fun f g h => by
    by_cases hf : f ∈ s.frames
    · exact (hfr.parent f hf g h).2
    · rw [single_parC hs, parIn_not_mem (by rwa [single_frames hs] at hf)] at h; cases h
  have key : ∀ {l : List Nat} (pre : List Nat), s.stk 0 = pre ++ l → l.Pairwise (· > ·) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro _ _; exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | cons a l ih =>
      intro pre hpre
      have hnd : (s.stk 0).Nodup := SC.stk_nodup hfr.nodup 0
      refine List.pairwise_cons.2 ⟨?_, ih (pre ++ [a]) (by simp [hpre])⟩
      -- every element below `a` in the stack is reached by parent steps, each decreasing
      have chainOK : ∀ (m : List Nat) (b : Nat), l = m ++ b :: [] ++ (l.drop (m.length + 1)) →
          b < a := by
        intro m
        induction m using List.reverseRecOn with
        | nil =>
          intro b hb
          have hl : l = b :: l.drop 1 := by simpa using hb
          have : s.parC a = some b := by
            rw [single_parC hs, hpre, hl]
            have hna : a ∉ pre := fun hm => by
              rw [hpre, hl] at hnd
              exact (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2 a hm a (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
            clear hb hl ih hpre hnd
            induction pre with
            | nil => simp [parIn]
            | cons x pre ihp =>

          exact hpar a b this
        | append_singleton m x ihm =>
          intro b hb
          have hx : x < a := ihm x (by
            rw [hb]; simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, List.length_append,
              List.length_singleton, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
            rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by simp)]
            simp)
          have : s.parC x = some b := by
            rw [single_parC hs, hpre]
            have hl' : pre ++ a :: l = (pre ++ a :: m) ++ x :: b :: l.drop (m.length + 2) := by
              rw [hb]; simp [List.drop_append_of_le_length]
            rw [hl']
            have hnd' := hnd; rw [hpre, hl'] at hnd'
            have hnx : x ∉ pre ++ a :: m := fun hm =>
              (List.nodup_append.1 hnd').2.2 x hm x (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
            clear hb hl' ihm hx hnd' hnd ih hpre
            generalize pre ++ a :: m = u at hnx
            induction u with
            | nil => simp [parIn]
            | cons y u ihu =>
              rw [List.cons_append, parIn_cons_ne (fun e => hnx (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..))]
              exact ihu fun hm => hnx (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)

      intro b hb
      obtain ⟨m, rest, hmr⟩ := List.append_of_mem hb
      exact chainOK m b (by rw [hmr]; simp)
  simpa using key [] rfl

/-- `EffAnchorOKC` of a single-context state is `EffAnchorOK` of its projection (Spec 1 §44;
WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_effAnchorOKC (hs : s.Single) (hd : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)) (x : Nat)
    (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOKC s x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s.toS3 x fd := by
  unfold EffAnchorOKC EffAnchorOK
  rw [single_flat hs]
  show OptP (s.toS3.A[s.toS3.effAnchor x]?) _ False ↔ _
  cases s.toS3.A[s.toS3.effAnchor x]? with
  | none => exact Iff.rfl
  | some z =>
    simp only [OptP]
    cases s.toS3.hframe z.holder with
    | none => exact Iff.rfl
    | some g =>
      simp only [OptP]
      cases fd with
      | none => exact Iff.rfl
      | some f => exact single_ancestorC hs hd g f

/-- `AnchorOrderC` of a single-context state is `AnchorOrder` of its projection (Spec 1 §44;
WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_anchorOrderC (hs : s.Single) (hd : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)) :
    AnchorOrderC s ↔ AnchorOrder s.toS3 := by
  unfold AnchorOrderC AnchorOrder
  rw [single_flat hs]
  exact forall_congr' fun q => imp_congr_right fun _ => forall₂_congr fun x _ =>
    single_effAnchorOKC hs hd x _

/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` of a single-context state is `AnchorOrderHeld` of its projection (Spec 1
§44; WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_anchorOrderHeldC (hs : s.Single) (hd : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)) :
    AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔ AnchorOrderHeld s.toS3 := by
  unfold AnchorOrderHeldC AnchorOrderHeld
  rw [single_flat hs]
  exact forall_congr' fun q => imp_congr_right fun _ => forall_congr' fun x =>
    forall_congr' fun y => imp_congr_right fun _ => imp_congr_right fun _ =>
      imp_congr_right fun _ => single_effAnchorOKC hs hd x _

/-- WC2 C24 ("the applicable sequential invariants"): on a single-context state, the re-indexed
kernel invariant is the frame structure together with the kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 on the
projection. -/
theorem single_kInvC (hs : s.Single) : KInvC s ↔ FramesC s ∧ KInv s.toS3 := by
  have hv : ∀ c, s.view c = s.toS3 ∨ I4 (s.view c) := fun c => .inr (i4_always _)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, hno⟩
    have hd := single_decreasing hs hfr
    rw [single_flat hs] at hw i1 i2 i3 hnd hno
    exact ⟨hfr, hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, i4_always _⟩, (single_anchorOrderC hs hd).1 hao, hnd⟩,
      (single_anchorOrderHeldC hs hd).1 haoh, hno⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfr, hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, hno⟩
    have hd := single_decreasing hs hfr
    refine ⟨⟨hfr, by rw [single_flat hs]; exact hw⟩,
      ⟨⟨by rw [single_flat hs]; exact i1, by rw [single_flat hs]; exact i2,
        by rw [single_flat hs]; exact i3, fun c => i4_always _⟩,
        (single_anchorOrderC hs hd).2 hao, by rw [single_flat hs]; exact hnd⟩,
      (single_anchorOrderHeldC hs hd).2 haoh, by unfold NoOrphanC; rw [single_flat hs]; exact hno⟩

/-! ### Results of operations -/

/-- Writing back kernel components keeps a single-context state (WC2 C2, C24). -/
theorem single_set (hs : s.Single) (t : S3) : (s.set t).Single := hs

/-- Projection of a write-back whose stack is the stack of the context (WC2 C24). -/
theorem toS3_set {t : S3} (hF : t.F = s.stk 0) : (s.set t).toS3 = t := by
  cases t; simp only [SC.toS3, SC.set] at *; rw [hF]

/-- The stack of context 0 after a write-back is unchanged (WC2 C2). -/
theorem stk_set (t : S3) (c : Nat) : (s.set t).stk c = s.stk c := rfl

end Single

    simp only [hv] at a b c d

  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, d⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [hv]
    · exact a
    · exact b
    · exact c
    · exact (hef _ _).2 d

/-- `store` of the single context: preconditions (Spec 1 §65; WC2 C24). -/
theorem storePreC_single (hs : s.Single) (hd : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)) {a p : Nat} :
    StorePreC s 0 a p ↔ StorePre s.toS3 a p := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  have hef := single_effAnchorOKC hs hd
  have ht : (storeEffC s 0 a p).toS3 = storeEff s.toS3 a p := by
    unfold storeEffC; rw [hv]; refine toS3_set ?_
    unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl
  have haoh := single_anchorOrderHeldC (s := storeEffC s 0 a p) hs hd
  rw [ht] at haoh
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a₁, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩
    simp only [hv] at a₁ b c d e f g h
    exact ⟨a₁, b, c, d, e, f, (hef _ _).1 g, h, haoh.1 i⟩
  · rintro ⟨a₁, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, haoh.2 i⟩ <;> simp only [hv]
    · exact a₁
    · exact b
    · exact c
    · exact d
    · exact e
    · exact f
    · exact (hef _ _).2 g
    · exact h

/-- `enterFrame` of the single context keeps a single-context state and pushes the new frame
(Spec 1 §72; WC2 C24). -/
theorem single_enterEffC (hs : s.Single) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    (enterEffC s 0 ps ls).Single ∧ (enterEffC s 0 ps ls).stk 0 = s.nF :: s.stk 0 := by
  have hC := single_C hs
  have : (enterEffC s 0 ps ls).C = [⟨s.nF :: s.stk 0, .live, none⟩] := by
    simp only [enterEffC, hC]; rfl
  exact ⟨⟨_, this⟩, by simp [SC.stk, this]⟩

/-- Projection of `enterFrame` of the single context (Spec 1 §72; WC2 C24). -/
theorem toS3_enterEffC (hs : s.Single) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    (enterEffC s 0 ps ls).toS3 = enterEff s.toS3 ps ls := by
  have hstk := (single_enterEffC hs ps ls).2
  have hv := single_view hs
  simp only [SC.toS3, hstk]
  simp only [enterEffC, SC.set, hv]
  rfl

/-- `enterFrame` of the single context: preconditions (Spec 1 §72; WC2 C24). -/
theorem enterPreC_single (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
    EnterPreC s 0 ps ls ↔ EnterPre s.toS3 ps ls := by
  have hd := single_decreasing hs hfr
  have hv := single_view hs
  obtain ⟨hs', hstk⟩ := single_enterEffC hs ps ls
  have hd' : ((enterEffC s 0 ps ls).stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·) := by
    rw [hstk]
    exact List.pairwise_cons.2 ⟨fun f hf => hfr.bound f (by rw [single_frames hs]; exact hf), hd⟩
  have hv' : (enterEffC s 0 ps ls).view 0 = enterEff s.toS3 ps ls := by
    rw [single_view hs', toS3_enterEffC hs]
  have haoh := single_anchorOrderHeldC hs' hd'
  rw [toS3_enterEffC hs] at haoh
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩
    simp only [hv] at b
    rw [hv'] at d
    exact ⟨a, b, c, d, haoh.1 e⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩
    refine ⟨a, by simp only [hv]; exact b, c, by rw [hv']; exact d, haoh.2 e⟩

/-- `exitFrameC` of the single context keeps a single-context state, pops the stack, and
reparents nothing (Spec 1 §73; WC2 C6, C24). -/
theorem single_exitEffC (hs : s.Single) :
    (exitEffC s 0).Single ∧ (exitEffC s 0).stk 0 = (s.stk 0).tail := by
  have hC := single_C hs
  have : (exitEffC s 0).C = [⟨(s.stk 0).tail, .live, none⟩] := by
    simp only [exitEffC, hC, reparent]; simp
  exact ⟨⟨_, this⟩, by simp [SC.stk, this]⟩

/-- Projection of `exitFrameC` of the single context (Spec 1 §73; WC2 C24). -/
theorem toS3_exitEffC (hs : s.Single) : (exitEffC s 0).toS3 = exitEff s.toS3 := by
  have hstk := (single_exitEffC hs).2
  have hv := single_view hs
  simp only [SC.toS3, hstk]
  simp only [exitEffC, SC.set, hv]
  rfl

/-- `exitFrameC` of the single context: preconditions (Spec 1 §73; WC2 C24). -/
theorem exitPreC_single (hs : s.Single) (hd : (s.stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·)) :
    ExitPreC k s 0 ↔ ExitPre k s.toS3 := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  obtain ⟨hs', hstk⟩ := single_exitEffC hs
  have hd' : ((exitEffC s 0).stk 0).Pairwise (· > ·) := by rw [hstk]; exact hd.sublist (List.tail_sublist _)
  have haoh := single_anchorOrderHeldC hs' hd'
  rw [toS3_exitEffC hs] at haoh
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩
    simp only [hv] at b c d
    exact ⟨a, b, c, d, haoh.1 e⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_, ?_, haoh.2 e⟩ <;> simp only [hv] <;> assumption

single-context state with the frame structure `FramesC`, every inherited operation O1–O16
executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of Spec 1 (§58, §60–§75) on the projection

  | enter ps ls => exact guarded_single hs (enterPreC_single hs hfr) (toS3_enterEffC hs ps ls)

import Ern.Concurrency.Frames

/-!
# Concurrent contract `K_C` and the kernel transition `deriveSync`

* `KC` (WC2 C2, C14): the Spec 1 contract `K` (§48, §80), reached by the projection `KC.toK`,
  extended with the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)`;
* `deriveSync` (WC2 C15): O1 (Spec 1 §60) on `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`,
  `mode = Modify`, executed by a live context, with the conjunct `ExercisableAt(source, mode)` of
  §60.1 replaced by `K_C.SyncAuthorized`; the other conjuncts of §60.1 and §60.2–§60.4 are kept;
* `CStepS`, the concurrent kernel steps with `deriveSync`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- External contract `K_C` (WC2 C2, C14): the unchanged Spec 1 contract `K` (§48), its
projection being `KC.toK`, and the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, guarded,
requesting_frame)` of WC2 C14. Obligations of `K_C` are hypotheses of theorems, never fields. -/
structure KC extends K where
  SyncAuthorized : SC → Nat → Nat → Prop

/-- Effect of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): a fresh active authority of mode
`Modify`, origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame of `c`;
this is the `ok` effect of O1 (Spec 1 §60) on the view of `c`. -/
def deriveSyncEff (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : SC :=
  s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) g ((s.view c).afp g) .modify)

/-- Preconditions of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): those of O1 (Spec 1 §60)
for `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`, `mode = Modify`, on the view of `c`, with
`ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` replaced by `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, current frame)`. -/
structure DeriveSyncPre (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : (s.view c).Active g
  /-- WC2 C15, replacing `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)` of Spec 1 §60.1. -/
  authorized : kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top
  /-- Spec 1 §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source` is active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g
  /-- Spec 1 §60.2: `Modify` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify
  /-- Spec 1 §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50). -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
      y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True
  /-- Spec 1 §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `deriveSync` (WC2 C15). -/
instance (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) [Decidable (kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top)] :
    Decidable (DeriveSyncPre kc s c g) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Active g ∧ kc.SyncAuthorized s g (s.view c).top ∧
    (∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
        y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True) ∧
    (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C15): `ok` or `reject` (Spec 1 §58 for kernel
transitions); no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def DeriveSyncStep (kc : KC) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DeriveSyncPre kc s c g) (deriveSyncEff s c g) o

/-- WC2 C15: the authority created by `deriveSync` is an ordinary authority of mode `Modify`,
origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame, active, of fresh
identity `|A|`. -/
theorem deriveSync_created {kc : KC} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat}
    (h : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s')) :
    s'.A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some g, (s.view c).afp g, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  rfl

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel (WC2 C2, C4, C6–C8, C15): a step of `CStep`
under the projection `K_C.toK`, or `deriveSync`. -/
inductive CStepS (kc : KC) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | base {s s' : SC} : CStep kc.toK s s' → CStepS kc s s'
  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat} : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s') → CStepS kc s s'

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Sync

/-!
# Reference synchronization library

Library state separate from `S_C` (WC2 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
1 §46, §55, §56):

* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC2 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
  `ControlOf` relationship (WC2 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
* `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3 and 5) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22);
* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized`, limited to registry and controller facts, and
  the contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC2 C14 ("unavailable outside the corresponding valid
  synchronization contract");
* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
* labelled library steps, runs, and the encapsulation hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC2 C22,
  C23, C25), a predicate on runs, never a precondition of a kernel operation.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Registry (WC2 C12) -/

/-- Synchronization entry (WC2 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
structure SyncEntry where
  guarded : Nat
  grant : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Synchronization registry (WC2 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry

/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC2 C12, "its declared field
positions"): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
ordered children of the mutex value. -/
structure MutexLayout where
  guardedField : Nat
  controlField : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC2 C12). -/
def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded

/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC2 C12). -/
instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance

/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (.place h) =>
    match parentOf s.P h with
    | some m =>
      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
    | none => none
  | _ => none

/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC2 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }

/-- Controller fact (brief, instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`): the frame `f` has an effective
mode on `ControlOf(e)`: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
present effective mode on the controller (the authority condition of Spec 1 §68.2). -/
def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False

/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance

/-- Library authorization for an entry (brief: registry and controller facts only): the entry is
live, its grant is available (`grant = none`), and the requesting frame has an effective mode on
its controller. -/
def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance

/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the library (WC2
C14, C25; brief: registry and controller facts only): an entry of the registry for `guarded`
authorizes the requesting frame. -/
def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance

/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library on the registry `reg` (WC2 C14, C25). -/
def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) : KC :=
  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L reg }

/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable ((libKC k L reg).SyncAuthorized s g f) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))

/-- Contract obligation of WC2 C14 ("unavailable outside the corresponding valid synchronization
contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the `guarded` of a
live entry. -/
def SyncSound (kc : KC) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s

/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC2 C14. -/

  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, -⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩

/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`

def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g

/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC2 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance

def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j

/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22): for every live entry with `grant = none`, no active descendant of
`guarded` covers a protected leaf. -/
def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded

operations remain coherent") has no formal content in WC2 and is not formalized (see the
report). -/

  place. -/

  leaf. -/

    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False

/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC2 C13), with `adm` the identities used
by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). Items C13.3 ("non-falsifiable"), C13.4 and C13.6
are not formalized (see the report). -/

    (c g : Nat) : Prop where

  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    ∃ q, y.holder = .place q ∧ s.flat.Usable q) False
  /-- WC2 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded`. -/
  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
  /-- WC2 C13.3: the controller association exists (positional `ControlOf`, WC2 C12). -/
  control : ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩ ≠ none
  /-- WC2 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/

    ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint s.P q ∧
      ∀ r ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P q r → l ∉ footprint s.P r) False
  /-- WC2 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
  /-- WC2 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/

  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧

import Ern.Concurrency.Frames

/-!
# Provisional by-value transmission at `spawn` (WC2 C5)

The composite of WC2 C5: `spawn` (WC2 C4) creating, among the locals of the new frame, a fresh
root `destination`, and the transfer of an owned `source` of the creator into it, with the
preconditions of O4 (Spec 1 §63) except the destination side of §63.1, replaced by WC2 C5.2–C5.3.

WC2 C5.4 evaluates the resulting-state conditions of O4 on the final state but does not say in
which state the other conditions are evaluated. Two of them depend on it: the source side of
§63.1 (exercisable `Modify` of the creating frame over the source, WC2 C5.1) and §63.4 (the
exemption of the grounding authority), since the spawn part moves the transmitted parameters to
the new frame. Both readings are defined (`SrcRightBefore`, `SrcRightAfterSpawn`) and
`readings_differ` exhibits a state where every other clause holds and the two readings disagree.
The composite relation itself is not defined: its definition requires that choice (see the
report).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Effect of the composite (WC2 C5 effect): the effect of `spawn` (WC2 C4), then the effect of
O4 (Spec 1 §63) from `src` to `dst` on the resulting state. -/
def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src dst : Nat) : SC :=
  (spawnEff s c ps ls).set (transferEff (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst)

/-- WC2 C5.2: `dst` is a fresh root local of the initial frame of the new context (its leaves are
`Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
construction of `spawnEff`). -/
def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i

/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC2 C5.2). -/
instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance

/-- Clauses of the composite whose state of evaluation is fixed by WC2 C4 and C5: C4.1, C4.3,
C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2); C5.2; the source side of §63.1 without the right (usability); §63.2, §63.3,
§63.5, §63.6 (first half) and §63.8 on the state where the destination exists, after the spawn
part; the resulting-state conditions §63.6 (second half), §63.7 and §63.9 on the final state
(WC2 C5.4). Not included: the source right of §63.1 and §63.4 (two readings below), the
resulting-state conditions of WC2 C4.5–C4.6 (state of evaluation not fixed by WC2: after the
spawn part or after the composite) and WC2 C4.6, C5.8 ("invariants hold", see the report). -/
structure SpawnValPreBase (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC2 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC2 C4.3: every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by the creating
  frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC2 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC2 C5.2: the destination is a fresh root local of the new frame. -/
  freshDst : FreshRootLocal s ls dst
  /-- WC2 C5.1 (Spec 1 §63.1): the source is usable. -/
  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
  /-- WC2 C5.5 (Spec 1 §63.2): same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l = .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3, WC2 C5.2: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l ≠ .init
  /-- WC2 C5.5 (Spec 1 §63.3): disjoint footprints. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧
    (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.pin l = false
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed, WC2 C5.4: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst)
  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed, WC2 C5.4: moved held authorities satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
  `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).A.length,
    AnchorMoves (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src x → ∀ q ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).P.length,
      (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable q →
      OptP ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
        y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) x
          ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.pframe q)) True
  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: the destination is usable in the final state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable dst

/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPreBase` (WC2 C5). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SpawnValPreBase k s c ps ls src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ FreshRootLocal s ls dst ∧ (s.view c).Usable src ∧
    SameShape (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst, (spawnEff s c ps ls).I l ≠ .init) ∧
    ¬ overlap (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src dst ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (spawnEff s c ps ls).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧
      (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src, (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat.Active x) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).A.length,
      AnchorMoves (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src x → ∀ q ∈ List.range (spawnEff s c ps ls).P.length,
        (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable q →
        OptP ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
          y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst) x
            ((spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock (spawnEff s c ps ls).flat src dst ∧
    (spawnValEff s c ps ls src dst).flat.Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- Source side of Spec 1 §63.1 and §63.4 for the creating context `c` in state `t` (WC2 C5.1,
C5.4): exercisable `Modify` over the source, and no active derived authority covering a source
leaf from outside the source except some grounding authority and its origin chain. -/
def SrcRight (t : SC) (c src : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight (t.view c) .modify src ∧
  ∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
      RightChain (t.view c) g j

/-- Decidability of `SrcRight` (Spec 1 §63.1, §63.4). -/
instance (t : SC) (c src : Nat) : Decidable (SrcRight t c src) := by
  unfold SrcRight; infer_instance

/-- Reading (a) of WC2 C5.1, C5.4: the source clauses are evaluated in the state before the
composite. -/
def SrcRightBefore (s : SC) (c src : Nat) : Prop := SrcRight s c src

/-- Reading (b) of WC2 C5.1, C5.4: the source clauses are evaluated after the spawn part, when
the transmitted parameters are held by the new frame. -/
def SrcRightAfterSpawn (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (src : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  SrcRight (spawnEff s c ps ls) c src

namespace TransferWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- Statics of Spec 1 `Examples.st` with frame 0 deriving a `Modify` authority (3) over leaf 0
(Spec 1 §60). -/
def w0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify)

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples in
/-- The two readings of WC2 C5.1/C5.4 differ (report, problem of WC2 C5): in `w0`, context 0
spawns a context transmitting authority 3 (a `Modify` derivative over leaf 0, held by frame 0) and
moves the value of place 0 into a fresh one-leaf local (place 3) of the new frame. Every clause of
`SpawnValPreBase` holds; the source right holds before the composite (through authority 3) and
fails after the spawn part (authority 3 is held by the new frame and blocks the root of place
0). -/
theorem readings_differ : SpawnValPreBase K0 w0 0 [3] [(none, 0)] 0 3 ∧
    SrcRightBefore w0 0 0 ∧ ¬ SrcRightAfterSpawn w0 0 [3] [(none, 0)] 0 := by
  decide

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-!
# Corpus runner (test module)

A computable executor for the corpus cases of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: the
kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75) and the arena operations O17–O19 of Part XIV (§76–§78), over
the library state of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (§46: the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena
registry). This module is a test module: no model module imports it.

* `Op`: one constructor per operation, with its arguments.
* `lstep k L o`: the outcome (§58) of `o` from `L`, computed from the decidable preconditions.
* `OpRel k L o`: the relation of the operation: the kernel relation `XStep` (§60–§75) with the
  registry unchanged; `NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`, `ResetD` (Part XIV) for the arena operations.
* `lstep_sound`: the computed outcome is an outcome of the relation, `ok`, `reject` and `fail`
  alike; `lstep_ok`: an `ok` step is a library step `LStep`.
* `lrun`, `final`, `RunsTo`: a run from `LState.init statics` (§47) whose steps are all `ok` reaches
  a library-reachable state (`LReach`) whose kernel state is reachable (`Reachable`, §57).

`newArena` consults the arena registry and no other registry (§56: `others = []`): the library
states of these runs hold no administration other than arenas.
-/

namespace Ern.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-! ## Test contracts (§48, §80) -/

/-- A test contract `K` given by lists (§48): the `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone` and
`Deallocable` sets, and the `FreeCompat` pairs; `ExternalDone` lists identities of dynamic pinning
obligations (§75). Nothing is declared disjoint; every allocation request is satisfiable. -/
structure KD where
  shared : List Nat := []
  pinned : List Nat := []
  done : List Nat := []
  dealloc : List Nat := []
  compat : List (Nat × Nat) := []

/-- The contract `K` (§48) described by a `KD`. -/
def KD.toK (d : KD) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ d.shared), (· ∈ d.pinned), (· ∈ d.done), (· ∈ d.dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ d.compat, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `DeclaredDisjoint` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : ∀ r r', Decidable (d.toK.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `SharedMutable` for a test contract (§48). -/

import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Minimal traces (test module)

Concrete states and runs used by the theorems of the concurrent milestone (constructions and
counterexamples), checked by `decide`. The corpus of WC2 §V (S1a–S15) is not covered here.

* a mutex value `m = {data, lock}` whose field `data` owns the protected storage `T` (WC2 C13,
  reference representation), its registration by `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`;
* theorem 4, counterexample without encapsulation: `derive(guarded, Observe, footprint(T))` by the
  exclusive owner makes `acquire` not enabled while `grant = none` (`acquire_blocked_by_derive`);
  the encapsulated twin enables it (`acquire_enabled`);
* theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant: a state with `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the library
  instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`, violating `I1`, where `deriveSync` is not enabled
  (`realizability_needs_i1`);
* frame transitions: `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` with reparenting, `terminate`, `join`
  (`frames_run`), and `join` on a live context has no outcome (`join_waits`);
* two `newMutex` on two protected roots owned by the same field share one controller
  (`shared_controller`, report).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Traces

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Mutex value (WC2 C12, C13) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `m`, `1` its field `data`, `2` its field `lock`, `3`
the protected value `T`, a root owned by `data`; every leaf `Init`. -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The reference layout (WC2 C12): `guarded` is held by the first field, the controller is the
second. -/
def L0 : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47): root authority `0` of `m` held by frame 0, root
authority `1` of `T` held by `data` (place 1). -/
def c0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem mst_ok : StaticsOK mst := by decide

/-- After `newMutex(guarded = 1)` (WC2 C13). -/
def reg1 : SyncReg := [⟨1, none⟩]

/-- `newMutex(1)` executed by context 0 is enabled on `c0`; its controller is place 2. -/
theorem newMutex_ok : NewMutexOk L0 [] c0 [] 0 1 (c0, reg1) ∧
    ControlOf L0 c0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-! ## Theorem 4: counterexample without encapsulation (WC2 C22) -/

/-- `derive(guarded = 1, footprint(T) = [3], Observe)` by context 0, the exclusive owner. -/
def c1 : SC := c0.set (deriveEff (c0.view 0) 1 [3] .observe)

/-- The derivation is an enabled kernel step (Spec 1 §60) and it is not encapsulated. -/
theorem derive_step : opStepC K0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe) 0 c0 (.ok c1) ∧
    ¬ Encap (c0, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe)) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, fun h => h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl⟩

/-- Theorem 4, second half (WC2 C22): after the non-encapsulated `derive`, the entry is live with
`grant = none`, `GrantDiscipline` fails, and `acquire` is not enabled. -/
theorem acquire_blocked_by_derive : (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live c1 ∧ ¬ GrantDiscipline c1 reg1 ∧
    ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk K0 L0 c1 reg1 0 0 st' := by
  refine ⟨by decide, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl
    exact (by decide : ¬ NoCoveringDesc c1 1) this
  · rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, -, hd, -⟩
    simp only [reg1, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at he
    subst he
    exact (by decide : ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) c1 0 1) hd

/-- The grant created by `acquire` on `c0` (WC2 C15, C16). -/
def c2 : SC := deriveSyncEff c0 0 1

/-- Registry after `acquire` (WC2 C16): the grant is authority 2. -/
def reg2 : SyncReg := [⟨1, some 2⟩]

/-- Positive twin (WC2 C16): without the derivation, `acquire` is enabled and records the grant. -/
theorem acquire_enabled : AcquireOk K0 L0 c0 reg1 0 0 (c2, reg2) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨1, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- State after `unlock` (WC2 C17). -/
def c3 : SC := c2.set (releaseEff (c2.view 0) 2)

/-- `unlock` is enabled after `acquire` (WC2 C17). -/
theorem unlock_enabled : UnlockOk L0 c2 reg2 0 0 (c3, reg1) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨1, some 2⟩, 2, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- An encapsulated trace `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` from `c0` with an empty registry (WC2
C13, C16, C17, C22). -/
theorem mutex_trace : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (c0, [])
    [.newMutex 0 1 [], .acquire 0 0, .unlock 0 0] (c3, reg1) :=
  .cons trivial (.newMutex newMutex_ok.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.acquire acquire_enabled) <|
  .cons trivial (.unlock unlock_enabled) .nil

/-! ## Theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant (WC2 C25; Spec 1 §50) -/

/-- `c0` with an extra active root `Modify` authority over `T` held by frame 0, unrelated to
`guarded` (violates I1, Spec 1 §50). -/
def bad : SC := { c0 with A := c0.A ++ [⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩] }

/-- Theorem 5 is false without the kernel invariant: in `bad`, `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and
the library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` hold for the current frame of context 0, `I1`
fails, and the preconditions of `deriveSync` fail (Spec 1 §60.3). -/
theorem realizability_needs_i1 : SyncInv L0 bad reg1 ∧ GrantDiscipline bad reg1 ∧
    LibSyncAuthorized L0 reg1 bad 1 (bad.view 0).top ∧ ¬ I1 bad.flat ∧
    ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) bad 0 1 := by
  have hl : ∀ {i : Nat} {e : SyncEntry}, reg1[i]? = some e → i = 0 ∧ e = ⟨1, none⟩ := by
    intro i e h
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [reg1] at h; exact ⟨rfl, h.symm⟩
    | succ i => simp [reg1] at h
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, by decide, fun h => ?_, by decide⟩
  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · intro e he _ g hg; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; cases hg
  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · intro i j e e' hi hj _ _ _; rw [(hl hi).1, (hl hj).1]
  · intro e he _ _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · have := h 1 2 ⟨.modify, none, [3], .place 1, true⟩ ⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ 3
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    cases this.1

/-! ## Frame transitions (WC2 C4, C6–C8) -/

/-- Context 0 enters a call frame (frame 1) without parameter nor local (Spec 1 §72). -/
def f1 : SC := enterEffC c0 0 [] []
/-- From frame 1, context 0 spawns context 1 (frame 2, parent 1) with one local (place 4) (WC2
C4). -/
def f2 : SC := spawnEff f1 0 [] [(none, 0)]
/-- Frame 1 exits; context 1 is reparented to frame 0 (WC2 C6). -/
def f3 : SC := exitEffC f2 0
/-- Context 1 terminates (WC2 C7). -/
def f4 : SC := termEffC f3 1

/-- A run of frame transitions (WC2 C4, C6–C8): `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` (reparenting
context 1 from the exiting frame 1 to its caller 0), `terminate`, `join`; each state satisfies the
frame structure `FramesC` re-indexed from Spec 1 §49.1 (checked where decidable: parents). -/
theorem frames_run : opStepC K0 (.enter [] []) 0 c0 (.ok f1) ∧ SpawnStep f1 0 [] [(none, 0)] (.ok f2) ∧
    f2.ctxParent 1 = some 1 ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 f2 (.ok f3) ∧ f3.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧
    TermStep K0 f3 1 (.ok f4) ∧ JoinStep f4 0 1 (.ok f4) := by
  refine ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) ?_⟩
  decide

/-- WC2 C8 (brief: waiting is a non-enabled transition): while context 1 is live, `join` has no
outcome. -/
theorem join_waits : ∀ o, ¬ JoinStep f3 0 1 o := by
  intro o h
  cases h with
  | ok _ hd => exact (by decide : ¬ OptP (f3.C[1]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False) hd

/-- `ancestorC` across contexts after `spawn` (WC2 C3): the creating frame 1 and the base frame 0
are ancestors of the initial frame 2 of context 1; after `exitFrameC`, frame 0 still is. -/
theorem ancestry : f2.ancestorC 1 2 ∧ f2.ancestorC 0 2 ∧ ¬ f2.ancestorC 2 1 ∧
    f3.ancestorC 0 2 ∧ ¬ f3.ancestorC 1 2 := by decide

/-! ## Two entries sharing a controller (report, WC2 C12 and C13) -/

/-- Statics: the mutex value `m = {data, lock}` and two protected roots `T₁`, `T₂` both owned by
`data`. -/
def mst2 : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state: root authorities 1 (of `T₁`) and 2 (of `T₂`) are both held by `data`. -/
def d0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst2)

/-- WC2 C12 requires distinct controller associations for different mutex instances; the
preconditions formalized from WC2 C13 accept `newMutex(1)` then `newMutex(2)`, and both entries
have the same positional controller (place 2). -/
theorem shared_controller : NewMutexOk L0 [] d0 [] 0 1 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    NewMutexOk L0 [] d0 [⟨1, none⟩] 0 2 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩, ⟨2, none⟩]) ∧
    ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-- A kernel step of Spec 1 keeps the stack, pushes `nF` (§72) or pops the top (§73). -/
theorem kstep_F {k : K} {t t' : S3} (h : KStep k t t') :
    t'.F = t.F ∨ t'.F = t.nF :: t.F ∨ t'.F = t.F.tail := by
  cases h with
  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .inl rfl

  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .inl rfl
  | enter h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .inr (.inl rfl)
  | exit h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .inr (.inr rfl)
  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .inl rfl

  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .inl rfl

pushes the fresh `nF` (§72, §49.1). -/
theorem reachable_decreasing {k : K} {statics : Statics} {t : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics t) : t.F.Pairwise (· > ·) := by

  | @step t t' hr hs ih =>
    rcases kstep_F hs with e | e | e <;> rw [e]
    · exact ih

    · exact ih.sublist (List.tail_sublist _)

theorem parIn_lt : ∀ {F : List Nat}, F.Pairwise (· > ·) → ∀ {f g : Nat},
    parIn none f F = some g → g ∈ F ∧ g < f
  | [], _, _, _, h => by cases h

    obtain ⟨hlt, hdF⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.1 hd
    by_cases e : a = f

      | nil => simp [parIn] at h
      | cons b F' =>

domain of `conservative_op`; with `single_kInvC`, the re-indexed kernel invariant holds there. -/

    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics t) :
    (SC.ofS3 t).Single ∧ FramesC (SC.ofS3 t) ∧ (SC.ofS3 t).toS3 = t ∧ KInvC (SC.ofS3 t) := by

  have hd := reachable_decreasing hdd hst h

  have hstk : (SC.ofS3 t).stk 0 = t.F := rfl

    · rw [hlt c hc, hstk]; exact hw.frames.1
    · rw [single_frames hs, hstk]; exact hw.frames.2.1
    · rw [single_frames hs, hstk]; exact hw.frames.2.2
