# Spec 2, jalon 1 — modèle abstrait concurrent : rapport

Branche `formal/spec2-m1`, créée depuis `main` (d0c2d87). Formalisation exploratoire, jamais mergée.
Candidate de conception : `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC2.md` (Working Candidate 2 corrigée), non normative, non commitée.
Référence normative : `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (ci-dessous « Spec 1 »).

Modules créés sous `formal/Ern/Concurrency/` : `Context`, `Frames`, `Conservativity`, `Sync`, `SyncLib`, `Transfer`, `Traces` (table du brief), plus `Preservation`, `Reparent`, `SyncPreserve` (théorèmes 2 à 4 ; la table du brief ne leur assignait pas de module). Tous sont importés par `Ern.lean`.

Vérifications finales : `lake build` (dans `formal/`) réussit sans avertissement ; le `grep` de `AGENTS.md` ne renvoie rien ; l'audit `collectAxioms` de tous les théorèmes `Ern.Concurrency.*` ne trouve aucun axiome hors `{propext, Quot.sound}` (§ b).

## (a) Passages lus et implémentés

### Lecture préalable (Spec 1, en entier)

§38 (état), §39 (frames), §40 (places, `Usable`, `RootHeld`), §41, §42, §43 (`effective`, `ExercisableAt`, `HasRight`), §44 (ancres effectives, `AnchorOrder`, `AnchorOrderHeld`), §45, §46, §47, §48, §49 (WF3), §50–§54 (I1–I4, `NoDangling`, `NoOrphan`), §55, §56, §57 ; §60–§73 (O1–O7, O8–O14, et §74–§75 O15–O16 lus avec eux) ; §76–§78 (O17–O19) ; §80 ; §82. WC2 : en entier (C1–C25, §IV, §V, §VI).

### Implémentation

| Passage | Lieu |
|---|---|
| WC2 C1, C2 (état `S_C`, contextes, cycle de vie, « current frame relative to the executing context », « globally live frame structure ») | `Context.lean` : `Life`, `Ctx`, `SC`, `SC.Live`, `SC.stk`, `SC.frames`, `SC.view`, `SC.flat`, `SC.set` |
| WC2 C3 (H1 : piles non vides, identités uniques, frame de base, parent de la frame initiale, `ancestor` étendu, bien-fondé) ; Spec 1 §39, §49.1 ré-indexés | `Context.lean` : `parIn`, `SC.ctxOf`, `SC.parC`, `SC.ancestorC`, `FramesC` |
| Spec 1 §44, §54 ré-indexés sur `ancestorC` | `Context.lean` : `EffAnchorOKC`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC` |
| WC2 C20 ; Spec 1 §49–§57 ré-indexés | `Context.lean` : `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3baseC`, `Inv3C`, `NoOrphanC`, `KInvC` ; congruence par appartenance (`wf3_mem_congr`, `i3_mem_congr`, `noDangling_mem_congr`, `SC.wf3_view`) |
| Spec 1 §60–§75 exécutées par un contexte (WC2 C2) ; §63.6–§63.7, §64.3, §65.4–§65.5, §72.4, §73.5 lues sur `ancestorC` | `Frames.lean` : `ViewStep`, `TransferPreC`, `DependPreC`, `StorePreC`, `EnterPreC`/`enterEffC`, `ExitPreC`/`exitEffC`, `opStepC` |
| WC2 C6 (`exitFrameC` = O7 + reparentage, C6.3) ; Spec 1 §73 | `Frames.lean` : `reparent`, `exitEffC`, `ExitPreC` |
| WC2 C4 (`spawn` sur O6) ; Spec 1 §72 | `Frames.lean` : `spawnEff`, `SpawnPreBase`, `SpawnStep` |
| WC2 C7 (`terminate`) ; Spec 1 §73 | `Frames.lean` : `termEffC`, `TermPre`, `TermStep` |
| WC2 C8 (`join`) | `Frames.lean` : `JoinStep` |
| WC2 C24 | `Conservativity.lean` |
| WC2 C2, C14 (`K_C`, projection sur `K`, `SyncAuthorized` opaque) ; Spec 1 §48 | `Sync.lean` : `KC` (`extends K`, projection `KC.toK`) |
| WC2 C15 (`deriveSync`) ; Spec 1 §60 | `Sync.lean` : `DeriveSyncPre`, `deriveSyncEff`, `DeriveSyncStep`, `deriveSync_created`, `CStepS` |
| WC2 C12 (registre, vivacité, `ControlOf` positionnel) ; Spec 1 §46, §56 | `SyncLib.lean` : `SyncEntry`, `SyncReg`, `MutexLayout`, `SyncEntry.Live`, `ControlOf` |
| WC2 C14, C25 (instanciation de `SyncAuthorized` par la bibliothèque ; obligation « unavailable outside the corresponding valid synchronization contract ») | `SyncLib.lean` : `CtrlRight`, `EntryAuth`, `LibSyncAuthorized`, `libKC`, `SyncSound`, `libKC_sound` |
| WC2 C21 (items 1, 2, 3, 5), C22 | `SyncLib.lean` : `SyncInv`, `CoveringDesc`, `NoCoveringDesc`, `GrantDiscipline` |
| WC2 C13, C16, C17, C18 ; Spec 1 §56, §62, §65.3 | `SyncLib.lean` : `NewMutexPreBase`/`NewMutexOk`, `AcquireOk`, `UnlockOk`, `ResetLockOk` |
| WC2 C22, C23, C25 (encapsulation comme hypothèse sur les traces) | `SyncLib.lean` : `Label`, `LStep`, `LRun`, `Encap`, `EncapsulatedTrace` |
| WC2 C5 ; Spec 1 §63 | `Transfer.lean` : `spawnValEff`, `FreshRootLocal`, `SpawnValPreBase`, `SrcRight`, `SrcRightBefore`, `SrcRightAfterSpawn`, `readings_differ` |
| Spec 1 §50 (I1) pour les grants | `SyncLib.lean` : `grants_exclusive` |
| WC2 §V (références seulement), traces minimales | `Traces.lean` |

Non formalisés (hors table du brief ou sans contenu formel) : C9, C10, C11 (descriptifs), C19 (administration synchronisée, `MetaRight`, Spec 1 §36), OB-C01 à OB-C06 (hors périmètre par construction, aucun modèle d'événements).

## (b) Audit des axiomes hérités

Méthode : script Lean (`collectAxioms` sur chaque théorème, et fermeture transitive des constantes utilisées par la valeur et le type de chaque théorème) exécuté sur `Ern` construit au commit d0c2d87. Les valeurs des théorèmes importés s'obtiennent par `ConstantInfo.thmInfo` (`value?` ne les renvoie pas).

1. `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.reachable_kinv` : `[propext, Quot.sound]`. De même `reachable_inv`, `init_kinv`, `kstep_preserves`, `op_preserves`.
2. Les 442 théorèmes des modules `Access/Main` (70) et `Access/Preserve/*` (Alloc 54, Common 1, DeriveSplitRelease 46, EndFree 71, Frames 112, Small 60, Transfer 28) : 342 dépendent de `[propext, Quot.sound]`, 64 de `[propext]`, 36 d'aucun axiome. Aucun ne dépend de `Classical.choice`.
3. Les trois preuves par `Classical.byContradiction` (`chainLen_step`, privé, `Access/Statics.lean:194` ; `Rename.perm_range_of_nodup`, `Access/Rename/Basic.lean:146` ; `Rename.shapeP_down`, `Access/Rename/Places.lean:264`) ont exactement 31 dépendants transitifs (34 théorèmes avec elles-mêmes), tous dans `Access.Rename.*` et `Access.StaticsConf.exists_renumber` : `Renumbered.{initRel, initSim, properties, reachable, reachable_back, rootIdx_α, rootPerm_perm, run, run_back, α.congr_simp, α.eq_1}`, `Sim.{run, run_back, run_back_any, step, step_back}`, `StaticsOK.renumbered`, `allocEff_down`, `allocEff_ren`, `alloc_corr`, `alloc_down`, `enterEff_down`, `enterEff_ren`, `enterPre_ren`, `enter_corr`, `enter_down`, `op_corr`, `op_down`, `renumber_renumbered`, `StaticsConf.exists_renumber`, `Renumbered.rootIdx_αg` (privé).
4. Dans tout `Ern` (3598 théorèmes), 136 dépendent de `Classical.choice` : les 34 ci-dessus et 102 autres de `Access.Rename.*`, `Access.StaticsConf.exists_renumber._proof_*` et trois lemmes privés de `Access/Statics.lean` (`idxOf_lt_of_key`, `iter_bound`, `nodup_length_le`), via des lemmes du cœur (par exemple `List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup`, `List.nodup_range`).
5. Le jalon 1 ne réutilise aucun de ces 136 théorèmes : la bisimulation `StaticsOK` (b) n'est pas utilisée. Pas d'arrêt après l'audit.

Audit des modules créés : 3xx théorèmes `Ern.Concurrency.*`, tous à `{propext, Quot.sound}` ou moins. Deux lemmes du cœur introduisaient `Classical.choice` et ont été remplacés par des lemmes locaux : `List.filter_eq_nil_iff` (→ `filter_nil_of`) et `List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem` (→ `nil_of_forall_not_mem` de la Spec 1).

Ce qui est fait sur `formal/spec2-m1` :

- **Audit des axiomes** : `reachable_kinv` et les 442 théorèmes de `Main` et `Preserve/*` n'utilisent que `{propext, Quot.sound}`. - **Modules compilés et commités** : `Context`, `Frames`, `Conservativity`, `Sync`, `SyncLib`, `Transfer` et `Traces`. Les 306 théorèmes existants sont tous dans `{propext, Quot.sound}`. Il n'y a ni `sorry` ni `native_decide`, et `lake build` passe sans avertissement.
- **Théorème 1** : il est prouvé pour O1–O16. Les issues coïncident une à une avec la Spec 1 sur les états à un contexte. `ancestorC` coïncide avec §39. Tout état atteignable de la Spec 1 entre dans ce domaine. Sans entrée de synchronisation vivante, `deriveSync` n'est jamais habilitée.
- **Théorème 5** : il est prouvé, mais avec en plus l'invariant noyau ré-indexé `KInvC`. Un contre-exemple vérifié montre qu'il est faux sous `SyncInv ∧ GrantDiscipline` seuls : sans I1, `deriveSync` n'est pas habilitée.
- **Théorème 6** : il est prouvé.
- **Contre-exemple du théorème 4** : il est construit. La dérivation `Observe` par le propriétaire bloque `acquire` alors que `grant = none`, et le jumeau positif l'habilite.
- **Problèmes de la candidate déjà relevés** :
  - « invariants » listés parmi les préconditions (C4.6, C5.8) ;
  - état d'évaluation d'O4.1 et d'O4.4 dans le `spawn` par valeur : un témoin `decide` montre que les deux lectures divergent ;
  - issue de `join` sur un identifiant inconnu ;
  - C12 exige des contrôleurs distincts, mais C13 ne le garantit pas : témoin avec deux mutex sur le même contrôleur ;
  - plusieurs clauses de C13, C17, C18 et C21 sans contenu formel.

**Pas encore fait :**
- **Agents en cours** : trois agents travaillent en parallèle dans des worktrees isolés. Ils prouvent la préservation (théorème 2) hors sortie de frame, le reparentage avec `exitFrameC` et `terminate` (théorème 3), et la préservation de `SyncInv` et `GrantDiscipline` sous `EncapsulatedTrace` (théorème 4).
- **Rapport** : il est rédigé (audit, passages, problèmes, décisions, écarts). Il n'est pas encore dans `formal/reports/spec2-m1.md`, faute des sections sur les théorèmes 2–4.

Je fusionne leurs modules et je finalise le rapport à leur retour.

Le composite `spawn` par valeur n'est pas défini tant que ses deux lectures ne sont pas tranchées. Sa préservation est donc ouverte, et les théorèmes 2–4 restent non vérifiés tant que les agents n'ont pas rendu leurs résultats.

**Where.** `formal/Ern/Concurrency/Reparent.lean`, commit `0ec5594` on branch `worktree-agent-a9df1b08eb590751f`. I fast-forwarded the branch to ad8c1bf first, because the worktree had started at d0c2d87. No existing file was touched and Ern.lean was not edited, so you need to add `import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` when you merge. The lake glob already builds the module. `lake build` passes with no warnings, there is no sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide/noncomputable, and all 64 theorems of the module depend only on `{propext, Quot.sound}`. I checked that with a module-scoped `collectAxioms` script: `scratchpad/forkB/AuditR.lean`.

**Public theorems** (namespace `Ern.Concurrency`, with `s`, `c`, `k` implicit):

- **Live frames and ancestry, `exitEffC_ancestorC`.** Hypotheses: `FramesC s` and `(s.stk c).tail ≠ []`. Conclusion:
  - `y ∈ (exitEffC s c).frames ↔ y ∈ s.frames ∧ y ≠ (s.stk c).headD 0`;
  - for `g`, `y` live after the step: `(exitEffC s c).ancestorC g y ↔ s.ancestorC g y`.
- **Same for `terminate`, `termEffC_ancestorC`.** Hypotheses: `FramesC s`, `(s.stk c).length = 1`, `s.ctxParent c ≠ none`.
- **Frame structure kept, `exitEffC_framesC`.** `FramesC (exitEffC s c)`, under the same hypotheses as `exitEffC_ancestorC`.
- **Same for `terminate`, `termEffC_framesC`.** Needs `c ≠ 0` in addition to the `terminate` hypotheses.
- **Reparenting target, `exitEffC_reparent` and `termEffC_reparent`.**
  - `s.parC f = some p`, so `p` is the immediate parent of the exiting frame `f`, not an arbitrary ancestor.
  - Every context live after the step gets `ctxParent d = if s.ctxParent d = some f then some p else s.ctxParent d`.
- **Kernel effect, `exitEffC_kernel` and `termEffC_kernel`.**
  - `A` and `D` equal `(exitEff (s.view c)).A` and `.D`.
  - `P`, `I`, `dead`, `pins` and `nF` are unchanged.
  - So reparenting changes only `C`.
- **Theorem 3, `exitFrameC_anchorOrder`.** From `FramesC s`, `WF3 s.flat`, `AnchorOrderC s` and an `ok` step `opStepC k .exit c s (.ok s')`, it gives `AnchorOrderC s' ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s'`.
- **Theorem 3, `terminate_anchorOrder`.** The same for `TermStep k s c (.ok s')`.
- **Theorem 2, `exitFrameC_preserves` and `terminate_preserves`.** From `KInvC s`, `RootHeldConv s.flat` and `HeldAnchored s.flat`, an `ok` step gives `KInvC s' ∧ RootHeldConv s'.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s'.flat`. The two auxiliaries are used only for their own conjuncts; the `KInvC` part needs `KInvC s` alone (`ReparentAux.Pop.kInvC`).

**How it is built.** The shared structure `ReparentAux.Pop` describes "pop the top frame `f` of `c`, reparent to `p`" and both steps instantiate it. Under it, the parent chain after the step is the chain before with `f` filtered out, which gives the ancestry result.

For `AnchorOrderC` I adapted Spec 1's `exit_anchorOrder` to `ancestorC`. That needed one extra fact the linear proof never uses: the holder frame of the surviving root anchor is itself a live frame after the step. It comes from `Frames.exit_root_survives`.

`WF3`, `Inv3base`, `NoDangling` and `RootHeldConv` reuse Spec 1's `Frames.exit_*` lemmas on `s.view c`, bridged to the new flat state by membership congruence. `HeldAnchored` follows the exit case of Spec 1's `op_preserves_heldAnchored`.

**Watch out.** `List.getElem?_modify`, `getElem?_modify_eq` and `getElem?_modify_ne` depend on `Classical.choice`. I replaced them with a local `ReparentAux.getElem?_modify'`. Forks A and C will hit the same thing if they rewrite the context list.

**Definitions and WC2.** I found no problem with C6 or C7, and no definition needed changing. One observation: `exitFrameC` can never reparent its own context's initial frame, because under `FramesC` that frame's parent is smaller than every frame of its stack. The proof gets this for free through the `repO` form.

I did not check how this module interacts with the files forks A and C are writing, or whether merging leaves duplicate helper names in the namespace.</result>

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity

/-!
# Reparenting at frame exit and context termination (WC2 C6, C7; OB-C13)

`exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed with the reparenting of WC2 C6.3) and `terminate` (WC2 C7):

* the frame structure after the step (`FramesC`), and the extended ancestry of the surviving
  frames, which is the ancestry before the step with the exiting frame skipped
  (`exitEffC_ancestorC`, `termEffC_ancestorC`);
* Theorem 3 (OB-C13): both steps preserve `AnchorOrderC` and `AnchorOrderHeldC`, and change `A`
  and `D` exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 (`exitEffC_A_D`, `termEffC_A_D`); reparenting
  targets the immediate surviving parent (`exitEffC_reparent`, `termEffC_reparent`);
* Theorem 2 restricted to these steps: `KInvC` and the auxiliaries `RootHeldConv`,
  `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 on the globally live frames are preserved (`exitFrameC_preserves`,
  `terminate_preserves`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace ReparentAux

/-! ## Lists -/

/-- Blockwise sublists give a sublist of the concatenation (WC2 C3). -/
theorem termEffC_ancestorC (hfr : FramesC s) (hone : (s.stk c).length = 1)
    (hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none) {g y : Nat} :
    (y ∈ (termEffC s c).frames ↔ y ∈ s.frames ∧ y ≠ (s.stk c).headD 0) ∧
    (g ∈ (termEffC s c).frames → y ∈ (termEffC s c).frames →
      ((termEffC s c).ancestorC g y ↔ s.ancestorC g y)) :=
  ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).mem_frames hfr.nodup,
   (termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).ancestorC hfr⟩

/-- WC2 C6.3 (OB-C13): `exitFrameC` reparents exactly the live contexts whose initial frame had
the exiting frame as parent, to the immediate surviving parent of the exiting frame (its caller),
and changes no other parent. -/
theorem exitEffC_reparent (hfr : FramesC s) (hcall : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []) :
    s.parC ((s.stk c).headD 0) = some ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) ∧
    ∀ d, (exitEffC s c).Live d → (exitEffC s c).ctxParent d =
      if s.ctxParent d = some ((s.stk c).headD 0) then some ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0)
      else s.ctxParent d :=
  ⟨(exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall).pf, (exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall).par⟩

/-- WC2 C6.3, C7 (OB-C13): `terminate` reparents exactly the live contexts whose initial frame
had the terminated initial frame as parent, to the immediate parent of that frame. -/
theorem termEffC_reparent (hfr : FramesC s) (hone : (s.stk c).length = 1)
    (hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none) :
    s.parC ((s.stk c).headD 0) = some ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) ∧
    ∀ d, (termEffC s c).Live d → (termEffC s c).ctxParent d =
      if s.ctxParent d = some ((s.stk c).headD 0) then some ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0)
      else s.ctxParent d :=
  ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).pf, (termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).par⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6, C6.6; Spec 1 §73 effect): `exitFrameC` changes the kernel
components exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`; reparenting changes only the
contexts, so it creates, elevates, revives and reanchors nothing. -/
theorem exitEffC_kernel (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    (exitEffC s c).A = (exitEff (s.view c)).A ∧ (exitEffC s c).D = (exitEff (s.view c)).D ∧
    (exitEffC s c).P = s.P ∧ (exitEffC s c).I = s.I ∧ (exitEffC s c).dead = s.dead ∧
    (exitEffC s c).pins = s.pins ∧ (exitEffC s c).nF = s.nF :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6, C7; Spec 1 §73 effect): `terminate` changes the kernel components
exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`. -/
theorem termEffC_kernel (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    (termEffC s c).A = (exitEff (s.view c)).A ∧ (termEffC s c).D = (exitEff (s.view c)).D ∧
    (termEffC s c).P = s.P ∧ (termEffC s c).I = s.I ∧ (termEffC s c).dead = s.dead ∧
    (termEffC s c).pins = s.pins ∧ (termEffC s c).nF = s.nF :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end Steps

/-! ## Theorems 2 and 3 for `exitFrameC` and `terminate` -/

section Main

variable {k : K} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat}

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6; Spec 1 §44, §73): an `ok` `exitFrameC` preserves `AnchorOrderC`
(not a precondition of O7) and establishes `AnchorOrderHeldC` (§73.5), with the reparented
initial frames. Fragment: states with the frame structure `FramesC`, `WF3` and `AnchorOrderC`
on the live frames. -/
theorem exitFrameC_anchorOrder (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s)
    (h : opStepC k .exit c s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderC s' ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  exact ⟨(exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.hasCaller).anchorOrderC hfr hw hao rfl hpre.anchors
    hpre.origins, hpre.anchorOrderHeld⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC2 C6, C7; Spec 1 §44, §73): an `ok` `terminate` preserves
`AnchorOrderC` and establishes `AnchorOrderHeldC`, with the reparented initial frames.
Fragment: as `exitFrameC_anchorOrder`. -/
theorem terminate_anchorOrder (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s)
    (h : TermStep k s c (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderC s' ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none := fun e => by
    have := hpre.hasParent; rw [e] at this; exact this
  exact ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.initialOnly hpar).anchorOrderC hfr hw hao rfl
    hpre.anchors hpre.origins, hpre.anchorOrderHeld⟩

/-- Theorem 2 for `exitFrameC` (WC2 C6, C20, C23; Spec 1 §57, §73): an `ok` `exitFrameC`
preserves `KInvC` and the auxiliaries `RootHeldConv` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 (not clauses
of §57) on the live frames. Fragment: O7 re-indexed. -/
theorem exitFrameC_preserves (hk : KInvC s) (haux : RootHeldConv s.flat)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s.flat) (h : opStepC k .exit c s (.ok s')) :
    KInvC s' ∧ RootHeldConv s'.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hfr := hk.1.1
  have hp := exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.hasCaller
  exact ⟨hp.kInvC hk (exitEffC_framesC hfr hpre.hasCaller) rfl hpre.anchors hpre.origins
    hpre.anchorOrderHeld, hp.aux hfr haux hh rfl hpre.origins⟩

/-- Theorem 2 for `terminate` (WC2 C7, C20, C23; Spec 1 §57, §73): an `ok` `terminate`
preserves `KInvC` and the auxiliaries `RootHeldConv` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 on the live
frames. -/
theorem terminate_preserves (hk : KInvC s) (haux : RootHeldConv s.flat)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s.flat) (h : TermStep k s c (.ok s')) :
    KInvC s' ∧ RootHeldConv s'.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg
  have hfr := hk.1.1
  have hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none := fun e => by
    have := hpre.hasParent; rw [e] at this; exact this
  have hp := termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.initialOnly hpar
  exact ⟨hp.kInvC hk (termEffC_framesC hfr hpre.nonInitial hpre.initialOnly hpar) rfl
    hpre.anchors hpre.origins hpre.anchorOrderHeld, hp.aux hfr haux hh rfl hpre.origins⟩

end Main

end Ern.Concurrency

- **Ancêtres et structure** : après la sortie, l'ancestry étendue est celle d'avant, la frame sortante en moins, et `FramesC` reste vraie.
- **Cible du reparentage** : les contextes reparentés sont exactement ceux dont la frame initiale avait pour parent la frame sortante. Ils sont rattachés au parent immédiat de cette frame, pas à un ancêtre quelconque.
- **Effet sur le noyau** : `A` et `D` sont exactement ceux de l'effet d'O7 dans la Spec 1 ; `P`, `I`, `dead`, `pins` et `nF` ne changent pas.
- **Ordre des ancres** : `AnchorOrderC` est préservé, alors que ce n'est pas une précondition d'O7.

L'agent n'a trouvé aucun problème dans C6 ou C7.

Avec ce module, la compilation passe sans avertissement et les 371 théorèmes `Ern.Concurrency.*` n'utilisent que `{propext, Quot.sound}`.

**Where it is**
- New file `formal/Ern/Concurrency/SyncPreserve.lean`, in one commit `bb12ec4` on branch `worktree-agent-a7d546d1100599a1e`, parent `ad8c1bf`. No existing file was changed and `Ern.lean` was not touched.

- The untracked `scratch/` folder in the worktree is not committed.
- `lake build` passes with no warnings, and the forbidden-term grep returns nothing.
- Axiom audit: all 401 `Ern.Concurrency*` theorems use only `{propext, Quot.sound}`.

**New definitions**
- `GrantSubtree s reg` (auxiliary, not a WC2 clause): while a live entry's recorded grant `g` is active, every covering descendant of `guarded` is `g` or a descendant of `g`. `GrantDiscipline` alone does not survive `unlock` without it.
- `RegBound s reg` (auxiliary): every registered `guarded` identity exists. Without it, a dead entry could look live once a fresh authority takes that identity.
- `SyncState L s reg := SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg`.
- `NewMutexLeaf L st lbl`: on a `.newMutex _ g _` label, the controller `ControlOf L st.1 ⟨g, none⟩` is a leaf. It is `True` for every other label.
- `EncapLeafTrace k L`: an `EncapsulatedTrace` that also requires `NewMutexLeaf` at each step.

**Theorems**
- Per step:
  `lstep_preserves (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap st lbl) (hnl : NewMutexLeaf L st lbl) (hw : WF3 st.1.flat) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2`
- Trace:
  `trace_preserves (h : EncapLeafTrace k L st lbls st') (Q : SC → Prop) (hQw : ∀ s, Q s → WF3 s.flat) (hQ : ∀ lbl st₀ st₁, LStep k L lbl st₀ st₁ → Q st₀.1 → Q st₁.1) (hQ0 : Q st.1) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2`
- Links between the trace predicates:
  - `EncapLeafTrace.encapsulated` turns an `EncapLeafTrace` into an `EncapsulatedTrace`.
  - `EncapsulatedTrace.leaf`: an `EncapsulatedTrace` with no `newMutex` label is an `EncapLeafTrace`.
- Counterexample, checked by `decide`:
  `newMutex_breaks_control : LStep K0 nmL (.newMutex 0 1 []) (nm0, []) (nm0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧ Encap … ∧ KInvC nm0 ∧ SyncState nmL nm0 [] ∧ ¬ NewMutexLeaf … ∧ ¬ SyncInv nmL nm0 [⟨1, none⟩]`
- Helpers in `Ern.Concurrency.SyncPreserveAux`:
  - `deriveSync_excluded`: under the library instantiation, a raw `deriveSync` must target a live `guarded`, which `Encap` forbids, so the step cannot happen.
  - `ctl_transfer`: a transfer that moves the whole mutex value keeps the controller at the same position.
  - Also the step skeleton (`Skel`, `HoldSame`, `PSkel`), the builders for each effect, and one preservation lemma per library operation.

**Hypotheses I need from theorem 2:** only `WF3` of `s.flat` before and after the step (part of `KInvC` and `ConcurrentWF`). For the trace version, any state invariant `Q` that implies `WF3` and is preserved by every labelled step.

**Open items:** none. All cases are proved, including `transfer` with the positional controller, `exitFrameC`/`terminate` reanchoring, and `acquire`/`unlock`/`resetLock`.

**Problems found in the definitions or WC2**
1. `NewMutexPreBase` only requires `ControlOf ≠ none`; it does not require the controller to be a leaf. Yet `SyncInv.control`, and C12's "synchronization-control leaf", do. In `nm0` the controller is place 2, which has a child, so a legal `newMutex` breaks `SyncInv` (shown by `newMutex_breaks_control`).
   - Proposal for the arbiter, not applied: add "the controller is a leaf" to `NewMutexPreBase`, as a reading of C13.3 "valid association" together with C12. Until then I carry it as `NewMutexLeaf`.
2. `GrantDiscipline` (C22) is not inductive on its own. `unlock` re-establishes it only if all covering descendants sit under the grant, hence the auxiliary `GrantSubtree`. WC2 states no such clause; C21.4 ("coherent") might be meant to cover it.
3. `Encap` as defined is sufficient for everything else. I did not add any encapsulation clause.

I did not check distinct controllers across entries (C12), since `SyncInv` doesn't include that clause, nor how this module merges with forks A and B; helpers sit in their own sub-namespace to avoid name clashes.</result>

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) are preserved by every labelled step `LStep` taken under the
encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC2 C22, C23), together with two auxiliary invariants that are
not WC2 clauses (`GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`). The kernel facts about the states before and after
a step (`KInvC` before, `ConcurrentWF` after) are hypotheses supplied by theorem 2 (preservation of
the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex` (WC2 C13) registers an entry whose controller (`ControlOf`) need not be a leaf, while
`SyncInv.control` (WC2 C21.3 with the "synchronization-control leaf" of WC2 C12) requires one:
the `newMutex` case is proved under the explicit hypothesis `NewMutexLeaf`, and
`newMutex_breaks_control` shows that the hypothesis is needed.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg
/-! ### `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` -/

/-- Hypothesis on a `newMutex` step: the controller of the new entry is a leaf (WC2 C12, "the
synchronization-control leaf"; not a precondition of `NewMutexPreBase`, see
`newMutex_breaks_control`). True for every other label. -/
def NewMutexLeaf (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .newMutex _ g _ => ∀ ctl, ControlOf L st.1 ⟨g, none⟩ = some ctl → isLeaf st.1.P ctl
  | _ => True

/-- `newMutex` (WC2 C13) preserves `SyncState` when the new controller is a leaf. -/
theorem newMutex_preserves {L : MutexLayout} {adm : List Nat} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg}
    {c g : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : NewMutexOk L adm s reg c g st')
    (hleaf : ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩ = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl) (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hes, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have hg := hpre.guarded
  unfold OptP at hg; split at hg
  · rename_i y hy
    have hnew : EntryOK L s ⟨g, none⟩ := by
      refine ⟨fun _ => by simp only [OptP, hy]; exact ⟨hg.2.1, hg.2.2⟩,
        (fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun hl => ?_, fun _ _ => hpre.available,
        (fun _ _ h => by cases h), lt_of_getElem? hy⟩
      cases hc : ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩ with
      | none => exact absurd hc hpre.control
      | some ctl => exact ⟨control_usable hw hl hc, hleaf ctl hc⟩
    refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun x hx => ?_, uniq_append hu fun x hx hl => hpre.unique x hx hl⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
    · exact hes x hx
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact hnew
  · exact hg.elim

/-- `acquire` (WC2 C16) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem acquire_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : AcquireOk k L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, e, hi, ⟨hl, hn, -⟩, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hes, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have heo := hes e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
  have hA : (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some e.guarded,
      (s.view c).afp e.guarded, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := rfl
  obtain ⟨e, hm, hg, hl, -⟩ := hpre.authorized
  exact he e hm hl hg.symm

end SyncPreserveAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Theorem 4, preservation half -/

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C21–C23), preservation: every labelled step taken under `Encap`, with a leaf
controller for `newMutex` (`NewMutexLeaf`), preserves `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5),
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) and the auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. The kernel
facts `WF3` before and after the step are parts of `KInvC` and `ConcurrentWF` supplied by theorem
2. Fragment: the concurrent kernel with the reference synchronization library. -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap st lbl) (hnl : NewMutexLeaf L st lbl)
    (hw : WF3 st.1.flat) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves h he hw hw' hs
    all_goals
      have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw
      exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @join s s' reg c d h =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | deriveSync h => exact (deriveSync_excluded h he).elim
  | newMutex h => exact newMutex_preserves h hnl hw hs
  | acquire h => exact acquire_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | unlock h => exact unlock_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | resetLock h => exact resetLock_preserves h hs

/-- An encapsulated trace (`Encap` at every step) whose `newMutex` steps satisfy
`NewMutexLeaf`. -/
inductive EncapLeafTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : EncapLeafTrace k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap st lbl → NewMutexLeaf L st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ →
      EncapLeafTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ → EncapLeafTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- An `EncapLeafTrace` is an `EncapsulatedTrace`. -/
theorem EncapLeafTrace.encapsulated {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapLeafTrace k L st lbls st') :
    EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons he _ hs _ ih => exact .cons he hs ih

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace` without `newMutex` step is an `EncapLeafTrace`. -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace.leaf {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st')
    (hno : ∀ lbl ∈ lbls, ∀ c g adm, lbl ≠ .newMutex c g adm) : EncapLeafTrace k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons st st₁ st₂ lbl lbls he hs _ ih =>
    refine .cons he ?_ hs (ih fun l hl => hno l (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl))
    cases lbl with
    | newMutex c g adm => exact absurd rfl (hno _ (List.mem_cons_self ..) c g adm)
    | _ => trivial

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C22, C23), trace form: along an encapsulated trace whose `newMutex` steps
have a leaf controller, `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the auxiliaries are preserved, given a
state invariant `Q` that implies `WF3` and is preserved by every labelled step (theorem 2 provides
it: `KInvC` with its auxiliaries). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : EncapLeafTrace k L st lbls st') (Q : SC → Prop) (hQw : ∀ s, Q s → WF3 s.flat)
    (hQ : ∀ lbl st₀ st₁, LStep k L lbl st₀ st₁ → Q st₀.1 → Q st₁.1) (hQ0 : Q st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons he hnl hst _ ih =>
    exact ih (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)
      (lstep_preserves hst he hnl (hQw _ hQ0) (hQw _ (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)) hs)

/-! ## `NewMutexLeaf` is needed -/

namespace SyncPreserveWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- A mutex value `m` (place 0) whose fields are `data` (place 1, a leaf owning the root `T`,
place 4) and `lock` (place 2, a structure with one leaf, place 3), owned by frame 0 (Spec 1
§47). Authority 1 is the root authority of `T`, held by `data`. -/
def nmStatics : Statics := [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
  ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 2, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The single-context state of `nmStatics`. -/
def nm0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init nmStatics)

/-- Field 0 holds `guarded`, field 1 is the controller (WC2 C12). -/
def nmL : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Frame structure of `nm0` (WC2 C3). -/
theorem nm0_framesC : FramesC nm0 where
  initial := by decide
  nonempty := fun c hc => by
    cases c with
    | zero => decide
    | succ c => exact hc.elim
  nodup := by decide
  bound := by decide
  rooted := fun c hc hl => by
    cases c with
    | zero => exact absurd rfl hc
    | succ c => exact hl.elim
  parent := fun f hf g hg => by
    have hf0 : f = 0 := by simpa [nm0, SC.frames, SC.stk, SC.ofS3, S3.init] using hf
    subst hf0
    have : nm0.parC 0 = none := by decide
    rw [this] at hg; cases hg

/-- Kernel invariant of `nm0` (Spec 1 §57 via WC2 C24). -/
theorem nm0_kInvC : KInvC nm0 :=
  (single_kInvC ⟨_, rfl⟩).2 ⟨nm0_framesC, (init_kinv (by decide)).1⟩

end SyncPreserveWitness

open SyncPreserveWitness Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples in
/-- `NewMutexLeaf` is needed (report: WC2 C13 does not require the controller to be a leaf): in
`nm0`, `newMutex(guarded = 1)` is enabled (`NewMutexPreBase` holds), every other hypothesis of
`lstep_preserves` holds (`Encap`, `KInvC` hence `WF3` before and after, `SyncState` with the empty
registry), the controller `ControlOf = 2` is not a leaf, and `SyncInv` fails after the step. -/
theorem newMutex_breaks_control :
    LStep K0 nmL (.newMutex 0 1 []) (nm0, []) (nm0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    Encap (nm0, []) (.newMutex 0 1 []) ∧ KInvC nm0 ∧ SyncState nmL nm0 [] ∧
    ¬ NewMutexLeaf nmL (nm0, []) (.newMutex 0 1 []) ∧ ¬ SyncInv nmL nm0 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  refine ⟨.newMutex ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, trivial, nm0_kInvC, ?_, fun h => ?_,
    fun h => ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, fun i j e e' h => by simp at h⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals (intro _ h; cases h)
  · have := h 2 (by decide); revert this; decide
  · have := h.control ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide); revert this; decide

end Ern.Concurrency

/-!
# Preservation of the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20, C23)

Theorem 2 of the exploratory pass, except `exitFrameC` and `terminate`: the kernel invariant of
Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (`KInvC`), with the auxiliaries of Spec 1 `reachable_inv` (`KAux`,
`HeldAnchored`) read on the flat state, is preserved by the inherited operations O1–O16 other than
O7 executed by a context (Spec 1 §60–§72, §74, §75; WC2 C2), by `spawn` (WC2 C4), `join` (WC2 C8)
and `deriveSync` (WC2 C15).

lemmas on the view of the executing context; the anchor orders are proved on `ancestorC`.

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The inductive invariant of theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23): `KInvC` (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed) with the
auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 `reachable_inv`, read on the flat state. -/
def KInvCA (s : SC) : Prop := KInvC s ∧ KAux s.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s.flat

import Ern.Concurrency.Preservation
import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncPreserve

/-!
# Theorems 2 and 4 on labelled steps and traces (WC2 C20–C23)

Assembly of `Ern.Concurrency.Preservation`, `Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` and
`Ern.Concurrency.SyncPreserve`:

* theorem 2 for every labelled step of the kernel with the synchronization library
  (`lstep_kInvCA`): `deriveSync` and `acquire` need the own mode `Modify` of `guarded`, which
  `SyncInv` (WC2 C21.1) provides for the library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`;
* theorems 2 and 4 together along an encapsulated trace (`trace_inv`), and from the initial state
  of Spec 1 §47 with an empty registry (`encapsulated_inv`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- WC2 C21.1: under `SyncInv`, the `guarded` of a live entry has own mode `Modify`. -/
theorem guarded_mode {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {e : SyncEntry}
    (hsi : SyncInv L s reg) (he : e ∈ reg) (hl : e.Live s) :
    OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False := by
  have h := hsi.guarded e he hl
  revert h; unfold OptP
  cases s.A[e.guarded]? with
  | none => exact id
  | some y => exact fun h => h.1

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23) on every labelled step (inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a
context, `spawn`, `terminate`, `join`, `deriveSync` under the library instantiation, `newMutex`,
`acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`): the re-indexed kernel invariant with the auxiliaries of Spec 1
(`KInvCA`) is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, for `split`) and `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, for the
own mode of `guarded` in `deriveSync` and `acquire`). Fragment: the concurrent kernel with the
reference synchronization library, without the by-value `spawn` composite. -/
theorem lstep_kInvCA {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hsi : SyncInv L st.1 st.2) :
    KInvCA st'.1 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    by_cases hx : op = .exit
    · subst hx; exact exitFrameC_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
    · exact opStepC_preservesC hdd hk hx h
  | spawn h => exact spawn_preservesC hk h
  | terminate h => exact terminate_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
  | join h => exact join_preservesC hk h
  | deriveSync h =>
    have hpre := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h.2).1
    obtain ⟨e, he, hg, hl, -⟩ := hpre.authorized
    exact deriveSync_preservesC hk (hg ▸ guarded_mode hsi he hl) h
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, hi, ⟨hl, -, -⟩, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
    exact deriveSync_preservesC hk (guarded_mode hsi (List.mem_of_getElem? hi) hl)
      ⟨hc, .ok hpre⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, g, -, -, -, hrel, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact opStepC_preservesC (op := .release g) hdd hk (fun e => by cases e)
      ⟨hc, _, .ok hrel, rfl⟩
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC2 C20–C23) along an encapsulated trace: from a state satisfying `KInvCA`
and `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and their auxiliaries), every state reached by an
`EncapsulatedTrace` satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd hst hk hs.1
    exact ih hk' (lstep_preserves hst he hk.1.1.2 hk'.1.1.2 hs)

/-- The initial state of Spec 1 §47 as a single-context state, with an empty registry (WC2 C3,
C12), satisfies `KInvCA` and `SyncState`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (L : MutexLayout) :
    KInvCA (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) ∧ SyncState L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨fun e he => by cases he, fun e he => by cases he, fun e he => by cases he,
    fun i j e e' h => by simp at h⟩, fun e he => by cases he, fun e he => by cases he,
    fun e he => by cases he⟩

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC2 C20–C23) on encapsulated traces from the initial state: every state
reached from the initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registry) by an
`EncapsulatedTrace` satisfies the re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and
`GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80) and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). Fragment:
the concurrent kernel with the reference synchronization library, without the by-value `spawn`
composite; encapsulation is the hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace`. -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2.1⟩

end Ern.Concurrency
